title: 4x4
description: When Ciro, a thug, breaks into a high-end 4x4 to steal the stereo, he gets trapped inside, as it turns out that the car has a security system that prevents any sound inside the car to get communicated to the outside, and hence Ciro's cries for help are not heard. Is there another way out for him?

title: 4 x 4 Reports
description: This was a BBC1 prime time current affairs show in a magazine style format. The title refers to four reporters on four angles of one big story. The concept was to have big name reporters or experts on the subject they were best known for.

Samar, a 2nd-year medical student, wonders if the soul has weight. He asks his professor for permission to conduct an experiment to measure it, but his professor refuses, citing it as inhuman and against the law.

title: Motu Patlu in Alien World
description: Motu finds out that his father, Mohan Sinha, an expert astronomer, is held captive by extra-terrestrial forces. Motu Patlu and friends embark on a space expedition to save him and bring him back.

title: Persona4 the ANIMATION
description: A young man, Yu Narukami has moved from Tokyo to Inaba to stay with his uncle and cousin, while his parents are away on business. However, after several murders shake up the sleepy town, things get crazier when he discovers the mysterious "Midnight Channel," and the ability to enter TVs. Accompanied by his friends, Yu explores another world inside the TV, that seems to be connected with the murders. They also discover the ability to summon 'Personas', their 'other selves', whose power they can use to fight the shadows that inhabit the TV world. The murders, the Midnight Channel, the world inside the TV, and Personas. Yu and his friends fight to figure out how they're connected, and to solve the case before it's too late.

description: Amir, a CEO in a courier company. He gets into trouble when an item in his courier worth RM150,000 went missing. It gets more frustrating when his wife never gives him moral support but belittling him instead and always try to find a reason to fight. One day Amir decided to leave home to find peace of mind. Amir is driving alone from Kuala Lumpur to Johor Bahru passing through 7 stops at the highway. At the first stop he met a beautiful lady named Sue. In a short period of time he falls in love with her, because she has qualities that his wife doesn't. However, something happened when he almost reach the seventh stop. Amir finally found out that Sue, the lady he's in love with has passed away, two days ago.

title: 7 Sins
description: 7 Sins is divided into seven segments, each one unique in its voice, acting, story, and style. While the seven deadly sins are cemented in Catholic Theology and are always the same, the interpretation by any single person is always different, and this assemblage is no exception. This film uses the themes within its subtext and introduces, and then wildly perverts, the punishments associated with the 7 Deadly Sins. The overall atmosphere is one of uneasiness that, in addition to a fair amount of disturbing visuals, is amplified by its pulse-pounding soundtrack.

title: 7 More Days in the Tank
description: A gifted stand-up comedian and talented U.S. Paralympic soccer player, Josh Blue refuses to bow to any of the challenges that come from living with cerebral palsy. He jokes, "I realize that people are going to stare so I want to give them something to stare at." He uses his self-deprecating sense of humor to defy stereotypes and encourage others to overcome their pre-conceived notions about disabled people. Blue - who was born in Cameroon, West Africa, and raised in St. Paul, Minnesota - got his start in comedy while pursuing a B.A. degree in creative writing from Evergreen State College in Olympia, WA. He now calls Denver, Colorado "home". In addition to guest-starring on Comedy Central's "Mind of Mencia," Blue has been making audiences laugh in top comedy clubs, theaters, colleges campuses and corporate events all over the country. At the 2004 Las Vegas Comedy Festival, he won the $10,000 Grand Prize at the Royal Flush Comedy Competition. In 2005, he earned rave reviews on the college circuit and a nomination for "Best Diversity Event of 2006." Describing his comedy as "spastic and engaging," Blue wanted to be on "Last Comic Standing" to "make people aware of the fact that people with disabilities can make an impact." Apparently he was right; on August 9, 2006 he won Last Comic Standing 4. In addition to being a stand-up comic, Blue is also a U.S. Paralympic soccer player, and he participated in the 2004 Paralympic Games that took place in Athens, Greece. The Paralympics, held two weeks after the Olympics, are the world's second largest sporting event. In "7 More Days in the Tank", Josh Blue returns to Denver for a stellar homecoming performance at the historic Gothic Theater. Recorded three days after his Last Comic win, the show had sold out three weeks before. Referring to the recent "liquids" scare on air travel, Josh asks himself: "Josh Blue, you just won Last Comic Standing. What will you do now?" "I thought I'd take down an airplane with shampoo!"

title: Come, Embrace Me
description: Preeti lives a wealthy lifestyle in Bombay along with her widower dad, Heerachand, and is a medical student. While on a trip to Simla, she meets and falls in love with a Casanova, Prem, and both get intimate. When her dad opposes this alliance, Prem challenges Heerachand regarding his daughter's love for him. He then leaves Preeti a note, explaining that her father refused the alliance and he was headed to meet his mother, who was urgently sick. Heerachand gets a hold of the letter before Preeti and changes the letter, writing that Prem went away as her father refused to provide any monetary compensation. Years later, both Prem and Preeti are fated to meet again. This time Prem is accompanied by a handicapped young lad, Rahul, while Preeti is about to get engaged to Dr. Amar. Preeti soon realizes that the reason Prem has re-appeared in her life to be near her nubile to-be sister-in-law, Tikki. The question remains what will she do under the circumstances to try and expose Prem as well as protect her past from Dr. Amar? It turns out that Rahul is Prem and Preeti's son and that Prem has come to Dr.Amar for Rahul's treatment. Preeti's father had told her after the birth of the child that she had given birth to a still-born child. After Rahul's operation Preeti comes to know about the reality and confronts her father who confesses to her that he had lied about her giving birth to a dead child and asks her forgiveness but Preeti retorts saying that she an never forgive him as he had lied to her and thinks herself deceived by her own father. Rahul's operation turns to be successful and Preeti and Prem are reunited with their son along with their families.

description: A doomed car is the center of comic situations in this story that follows Ammy Virk, who belongs to a middle-class family of 8. His materialistic father is convinced by him to let him marry the girl of his choice. A small car is given by the girl's family as a dowry, and that pleases the father's greed. title: Kristiane af Marstal
description: Hans and Poul sail a two-man freighter from Copenhagen to the province. Somewhat impractical, they are both in love with Margit, and an unhappy Hans is left when she chooses Poul. But on the sleepless wedding night, Hans hears a splash, and out of the water he fishes the young Kristiane with a tragic past.

title: Pojken i trädet
description: Gote is a young teen who seems to be at odds with his family and may not know his own mind that well either. Discontented and rebellious, Gote joins up with two mean-spirited game poachers in spite of the fact that he loves animals and nature. This contradiction between his own feelings and his need to rebel reaches a climax when a forest ranger starts to track down the young men in ever-tightening circles.

title: Af Paam Lo Meuchar
description: After spending eight years in the farthest reaches of South America, 30-year-old Herzl returns home to Israel. With no ambitions or prospects for the future, he finds a job hanging posters across the country. Driving his a 1985 Volvo, with a pile of dusty Israeli folk tapes on the dashboard and a worn copy of Robinson Crusoe by his side, a young man journeys across the Israeli landscape, coming to terms with the memories of what he left behind.

title: The Health Journey
description: Stig-Helmer has returned to Sweden after the divorce from Fiona, and lives a sad and stagnant life in front of the television. As usual his enthusiastic and energetic friend Ole knows how to get his pal out of the boring existence he finds himself in. The eccentric Rebekka is a whole new acquaintance, who radically is going to change Stig-Helmer's life.

title: Language of Love
description: A modern advanced film about sexual education an behaviour based on the clinical research made by famous American and Swedish doctors. The film centres around a panel; Inge and Sten Hegeler, Maj-Brith Bergstroem-Walan and Sture Cullhed, all well known, reputable experts, who have devoted their scientific studies to the various fields of sexual life. The film deals with all kinds of problems connected with the sexual relationship of people. Whilst every question is discussed by the panel., the film illustrates; the difference between male and female sexual organs and their functions, positions, and authentic coition whereby a split screen system is used enabling us to see the various reactions in different parts of the body. In connection with this as well as in other parts of the film, diagrams and animations are used to simplify the understanding of the complicated reactions which occur when a person is under sexual stimulus. The panel also discusses the role of sex in society, the question of prejudices and taboos, sex in clothes, sex in art, etc. etc.

title: Putting Lipstick on a Pig
description: Paivi is in her 50's and lives on Aland, an island in Finland with 30 000 people. We have our own government which can decide some things independently of the Finnish government: taxes, hunting, gambling etc. Paivi is a single mother and when her boys move out she is alone. She looks for company online and finds gambling. She gets addicted. She is an accountant and has access to money. Things go out of hand. Suddenly she has lost 819 000 - of her clients money! She is caught and it is a big scandal. She tries to commit suicide but gets jail. The clients are angry, they trusted her! It gets worse. It turns out she lost it all to the local gambling company. They hold a monopoly license to prevent from addiction and criminality - exactly what they didn't. The money went to the local government and they distributed it to the people: to football associations, research etc. It all turns into a money laundry case, the first in Finnish legal history to involve a gambling company. But the government refuses to pay back the money which make Paivis former clients furious. The movie had a preview on Aland where it ran for four days and won the audience award. Public opinion became strong and the government now have to plan on how to pay back and how to prevent this from happening again. But people get addicted to gambling everyday. Right now someone is losing everything. Right now, a gambler filled with guilt tries to kill herself. This is just the story of one gambler.

Chronicling the trials and tribulations of three young Tamil men. A bright underachiever, the impressionable 23-year old Anpu, who lives with his no-nonsense disciplinarian father. Trapped in a self-perpetuating cycle of isolation, Anpu finds salvation with a local gang. A charismatic gang leader Kumar, who maintains a strong sense of comradely and a code of honour among his members. Gang life is not something he enjoys nor he chose, but circumstances forced him into it and he is waiting for an opportune time to get out. And, far removed from them is an ambitious student Ahilan, who has managed to surmount enormous challenges in life through his positive outlook and determination. They have treaded very different paths in their lives, yet their fates become inexorably tied to each other's. Anpu's involvement in Kumar's gang blossoms into a strong friendship between the two, based on trust and respect. Former classmates and friends, Ahilan and Anpu have grown distant over time due to a girl in their lives. These young men's stories couldn't be more different, yet one thread links them all. All of them are victims of the brutal civil war in Sri Lanka. That fateful bright Saturday starts like any other, and no one could have predicted the chain of events that are about to unfold that will change their lives forever.

title: Ah! My Goddess: Flights of Fancy [English] S1-S2
description: Set one year after Aa. Megami-sama!. The song may say thank heaven for little girls, but whom is college student Morisato Keiichi supposed to thank when three honest to goodness Goddesses move in and take over his life? And should he really be all that grateful? After all, according to most mythologies, relationships between mortals and immortals usually leads to mortifying complications, so we're already talking about an extremely mixed blessing. And when a fourth Goddess suddenly appears, that blessing quickly becomes a curse. Keiichi's new friends may be trying to help, but sometimes Belldandy, Skuld, Urd, and Peorth seem less concerned with Keiichi's safety than they are with establishing a pecking order and ownership rights. The delicate celestial balance that exists between human and goddess is thrown into complete and utter chaos.

title: Ai Que Vida!
description: Cleonice decides to run for mayor while his son, Valdir, pays his respects to a philanthropic institution and ends up falling in love with a girl. In the fictional Poço Fundo, politics and affection mingle in saga against corruption.

title: AI Amok
description: Artificial Intelligence has permeated every aspect of planetary life in 2030. Tokyoites experience AI in every aspect of their lives whether medical, finance, transportation or their personal and day-to-day interactions. Many would tell you that AI is indispensable. Yet, as is often the case with technology jumping the gun on ethics and rules AI spins out of control and causes calamity after calamity. The city and the country are in chaos.

title: Ai no kudaranai
description: Kei Tamai, an assistant producer at a regional TV station, is trying to have a baby with her live-in boyfriend Yoshi. He says he'll marry her once she gets pregnant, having given up his dream of making it big as a comedian, and frequently skips work, which has gradually cooled Kei's feelings for him. She secretly takes contraceptives, and devotes herself to her job. One day, Kei's irritation with the whining Yoshi reaches a peak, and she starts to walk out on him. In desperation, he tries to stop her by dropping a bombshell: "I'm pregnant, so let's get married." As Kei's career and relationship go off the rails, she is forced to confront her own obliviousness.

title: Ima ai ni yukimasu
description: Yuuji is still a first-grade student, he is having a very hard time understanding what has happened to his mother and the fact that she won't be coming back. At the very beginning , the voice of the late mother is reading from a picture book that she wrote for Yuuji before she died. It is about a mother who dies, but promises to return when the rainy season comes. Yuuji believes in this story and thinks that his mother will come back when the rainy season comes. And surprisingly - she actually does. When it begins raining on a June morning, Yuuji runs out into the forest to the special place where he used to play with his mother. His father, Takumi chases after him to get him to go to school. When they arrive at the old ruined building where they used to play, Yuuji's mother, Mio is waiting there completely alive and healthy, but she has no memory of them or anything that occurred during her life.

title: Ai Weiwei's Turandot
description: AI WEIWEI'S TURANDOT follows Chinese artist/activist, Ai Weiwei, during his operatic directorial debut at Rome Opera House, as he draws on Italian composer Giacomo Puccini's Turandot, as a backdrop for many issues that plague mankind.

title: Ai no uta
description: A drama about a man and woman who come to know true love after unexpected circumstances cause them to live under the same roof. Singer and songwriter Tamaki Koji returns to acting after a 8 year hiatus, to star opposite Kanno Miho in this drama. Koji plays a very kind policeman; a champion of the weak and a pacifist. Having lost his wife 4 years earlier, he has been saddled with the arduous task of raising 3 children single-handedly. Kanno stars as the unfortunate heroine with an ugly personality who grows through her encounters with this good natured middle aged man.

title: Ai wo tsumu hito
description: Atsushi was a dedicated and serious worker for all of his adult life. Now retired to the northern territory of Hokkaido with his wife Ryoko, Atsushi is at a loss with what to do with all the time on his hands. As Atsushi busies himself with erecting a stone gate to surround their new home, a local lad is recruited to help, the couple's reconciling daughter comes to visit and Ryoko holds a secret close to her bosom.

title: In coda ai titoli
description: "In Coda Ai Titoli" is a collection of beautifully photographed interviews with the people behind the scenes in the history of the great Cinecitta studios in Rome. Electricians, Grips and others speak about the stars of the old times and give us an inside view of their secret attitudes and behaviors.

title: Love at Least

She lives with her boyfriend Tsunagi, who works in the editorial department at a magazine. Her frustration grows, because she can't control her emotions and her boyfriend seems indifferent to her. One day, Tsunagi's ex-girlfriend Ando appears. She schemes to break up the couple.

title: My Sibling's Romance China
description: Four pairs of biological siblings move into a shared house to find love under each other's watchful eyes. title: Ai cao
description: A woman who believes she chose an unconventional path in her life is startled to find her children are stepping farther beyond society's boundaries in this drama from Taiwanese filmmaker Hsiu-Chiung Chiang. Ai-tsao (Li-li Pan) is a widow who is nearly 60 years old; her husband, over twenty years her senior, has been dead for nearly two decades, and Ai-tsao's life has settled into a comfortable routine of looking after her elderly mother and doting on her two adult children. Ai-tsao had a strong independent streak when she was young and struck out on her own over the objections of her parents, but she's not quite as willing to accept that her children have chosen lives different from her own. Ai-tsao slowly comes to the realization that her son is gay and struggles to come to terms with his lifestyle, but it's even more difficult for Ai-tsao when she discovers her daughter is going to be the unwed mother of a mixed-race child.

title: Ai no onimotsu
description: Jozaburo Araki is the head of a famous family-owned wholesale pharmaceutical store with a well-established history. At present he is the Minister of Health and Welfare, and is considering submission of a Bill to hold population increase in check, in an attempt to easily deal with Opposition accusations regarding the population problem. However, just when he is in the Diet giving a major policy speech to the Welfare Ministry Committee about decreasing the population, Ranko, his 48-year-old wife, heads to a maternity clinic and discovers that she is pregnant. To make matters worse, he finds out that his eldest son, Jotaro, had been secretly having an affair with his own secretary, Saeko Godai, and it seems that she is also expecting a little 'Burden of Love.' Also, the Araki family's young daughter, Sakura, has become pregnant with her fiancé before their upcoming marriage, and even the retired patron of the family, Jozo, 2 presents yet another possibility of a pregnancy with his much younger mistress. Furthermore, Jozaburo visits Kyoto on an election campaign and is astounded to learn of the existence of his own love-child with his former lover, Some Kaida! As if that's not enough trouble, the Araki family finds that even their maid, Oteru, and their business manager, Yamaguchi, have somehow also ended up with their own 'Burden of Love.' And that is how the population explosion in the household of the Minister of Health and Welfare somehow becomes a factor in the future of Japan...

title: World According to AJ
description: Series One - Enter A.J's world, he is a museum assistant who often finds himself in some chaotic situations, be it, a lost tomb, unearthing a forgotten civilization, or just trying to win over the girl. Along for the ride are best friends Tim and Jamie. Mells is also there to keep the boys in line, there is however one twist to all of this, A.J has a remote, one that allows its user to go back to the past. Who knows what he'll face and can he keep both worlds separate? Series Two - After the events of last series A.J must deal with the consequences of his actions as he tries to settle back home. It's not easy for Tim either who has been kicked out by Mells. The pair are now living as flatmates once again and a new set of adventures awaits them. Can things really be fixed? New Allies, New Enemies and more might answer these questions before the whole world comes crashing down.

description: Rudra Pratap Sharma comes from an aspiring Hindu 'Bramhin' family consisting of his dad, Dayashankar, a bank manager by profession, his mom Sharda and a much younger sister Gaithri. The family resides in Banaras, India; Rudra cannot stand injustice in any form and revolts by publicly beating some college-bullies. This forces him and his family to re-locate to the city of Bombay where Rudra continues to deal with wrong-doers by turning them over to the law. Then one day his life changes when he is arrested by the police for not only dealing in arms and ammunitions but for the cold-blooded murder of the Commissioner of Police Yeshwant Sinha. Rudra must now escape from prison to find out who frames him and if at all he can put his life back together.

title: Enakkule
description: Two childhood friends, a boy and girl who spends time together in primary school. One day that boy's parents lost their lives in a horrific road accident in front of that girl. Thereafter, the girl become his whole world and he is ready to do anything for her. Meanwhile, the girl's mother is suspicious about their relationship and therefore they forced the girl to get marry. After the marriage, the boy feels lonely. At the same time the girl also facing a very hard time that putting her life at risk. The boy takes a weird decision that saves her life and solve many puzzles, but..

title: Ye Ladki Bhi Na...
description: The journey of a young girl through various relationships in her life.

title: A Week to Time Travel
description: In the near future, Ankit a common man living in the city is shortlisted for a Time Travel program by the Intellectual Society. He has one week left in hand to take part in the program. In the course of that time he meets some people and certain incidents in his life influence him to think about whether he should really be part of this program or not.

title: Sandik
description: The fate of Turan Village, which a charming village located in an area of great natural beauty surrounded by mountains, canyons and rivers far away from the city, will change with the departure of unknown helicopters.

title: Sultana
description: Sultana

title: One Day A Boy
description: Despite being a successful and rich pedagogue, Mete, who has an unhappy family life, goes to a Love House in the countryside for his doctoral thesis. For Mete, who meets children who are happy despite all their shortcomings, nothing will ever be the same again.

title: Al Dahik Al Baki
description: The events depict the story of the famous actor Naguib El Rehany since childhood and highlight the human and social aspects of his life, as well as the political events he witnessed, especially the 1919 Revolution, the First and Second World Wars, the Constitution of 1923, and the British occupation of Egypt.

title: Al Hay Al Khalfi
description: The story revolves around a poor family living in a marginalized neighborhood in the city of Casablanca. The father is a gambling addict, the mother is an elderly woman, and the children face various conditions.

title: Al Hesla Al Aela 007
description: Al Hesla Al Aela 007

title: Kheit al rafeigh, -al
description: (Mona) A poor girl who works as a simple employee at a bank and provides her family. Under the pressure of need and illness of her father and the pressure of her mother, which insists on her to increase her income, she gets a wealthy old businessman to love her. An engineer (Adel), who works in the company of her lover (Abdo) reveals his love, she convinces him to resign and build his own independent company and give him jewelry as a capital and stand by him and encourage him and cut ties with (Abdo). Will their love story continue?

title: Al Theeb Fi Al Qaleeb
description: In a comic framework, an accountant is accused of embezzlement and finds himself forced to facing his family members 'contradictory positions on the case while trying to prove his innocence.

title: Akher Al Rejal Al Mohtaramen
description: A Teacher in Upper Egypt is assigned to supervise a students' trip to Cairo as the trip doesn't go as planned, he has to find a way to make things right, but things get complicated and run against his moral values.

title: Al Zoga Al Raba'a
description: The story revolves around Fawaz Al-Sayyad, a businessman who wears white robes, does not leave the rosary, does not shake hands with women, at the same time, deals with his three wives as a neighbor and the fourth, changes her whenever he wants, and deliberately prevents her from having children, so that he can easily divorce her, until his wives revolt He must and lose everything, so he begins to re-calculate his accounts again and try to repair himself.

title: Al-ayyam al-tawila
description: In 1959 underground revolutionaries try to assassinate Prime Minister Abd al-Karim Kassem in Baghdad. News reports claim they have failed, and at first the revolutionaries lay low, but as the secret police continue to comb the neighborhoods with house-to-house searches, they flee to the countryside. Among those fleeing is Saddam Hussein, the future president of the republic.

title: Al-Hob Wa Al-Salam
description: The events of the series alternate between two periods of time, the first during the first Gulf War, and the second in a state of siege during the era of the Baath regime

title: Al-Qamar Akher Al-Dunya
description: As Dalal returns from abroad with her husband Khaled, she is surprised to learn that her mother, Karima, has disappeared, leaving Dalal to looks for her with her brothers Galal and Ahmed. Ahmed.

title: Al faris wa al chaki
description: Essam is a young man from a wealthy aristocratic family who falls in love with the poor girl Amal. He takes her to his family's home, but the family does not welcome her. Amal's past comes back to haunt her.

title: Al Iiftar Al Akhir
description: The love story of a married couple separated by death after the wife died while they were having breakfast. Their love and the details the husband holds about her remain in his memory full of events. While a strong desire to catch up with his wife arises within him, he meets a person full of energy who gives him a new perspective on life.

title: Al-Ameed
description: Among the Syrian refugees who were forced out of their country due to the war, the dean of a Lebanese college is forced to leave his job behind and turn his attention into investigating a mystifying crime.

title: Al eeteraf al akhir
description: Adham a faithful husband still mourning his deceased wife,visited one night by a woman in white revealing her secret love for him since college,and his wife true acts behind his back,but the big revelation was this woman is no longer from the living and its her ghost that paid him a visit.

title: Al-Hsnaa We Al-Les
description: Ahmed is a thief who saves Amina from an attempted suicide. As he takes her to his home to stay with his family, he decides to repent and stop stealing. The gangster, Al-Nemr, tries to convince him to stay, but when Ahmed refuses, Al-Nemr kidnaps Amina to force Ahmed into submission.

title: Al-Amira & Al-Nahar
description: Princess Olmina must complete 3 tasks to become queen: swim the Tigris, cross the desert, and climb Mount Zagros. She fails the last task, but learns the importance of family and teamwork.

title: Al Tawarid
description: The leader of the Tawarid tribe, finds two infants, Khalaf and Mahawish, and orders for the women to breastfeed and look after them. The two become milk-brothers to almost all of the tribe's girls, except for Wadha.

title: Salah Al-deen Al-Ayyobi
description: A Syrian series about the crusades and the Muslim leader Saladin and his conquest of Jerusalem.

title: Al-mufattish al-amm
description: When a penniless fertilizer inspector visits a village, its mayor mistakes him for an Inspector General sent to investigate charges of corruption.

title: Gaana Al-Bayan Al-Taly
description: Nader Seif Al-Din dreams of becoming a TV presenter for The Truth channel, but as he doesn't have any connections, he and his colleague Effat Al-Sherbiny are rejected. When they start working as news editors, they learn confidential information about Riad Ghanem's dairy factories.

title: Al Sada Al Afadel
description: After their father's death, the Abu AL-Fadl family faces debts and chaos. Brothers Tarek and Hejazi try to fix things, but a mysterious man's demands turn their efforts into disaster.

title: Ahlam Al Fata Al Taeer
description: The series revolves around Ibrahim Al Taeer's release from prison and his return to his usual theft activity. He performs a huge operation to smuggle 750,000 pounds, and hides with the smuggled money in a mental hospital in agreement with the hospital director alone with nobody else knowing. He kills the director of the hospital, then flees with another patient to escape from the police and the gang who wants the smuggled money.

title: Al Bshtakhtah
description: A young man who resigned from the private sector sells antiques at the Friday market, benefiting from his father's love of collecting. After discovering a rare piece and a foreign trader offering a high price, he rejects it out of respect for his father's cassette tape instructions. These tapes open new doors to mysteries and influence the course of his life .

title: Al Dariya
description: To honor his father's will, Youssef turns to drug smuggling. But his success crumbles when he clashes with an arms kingpin, a relentless officer, and greedy kin in a deadly game of survival.

title: Al Madinah Al Tarfeehya
description: The work evokes childhood memories and the beauty of the past. Its story revolves around two young men who visit an abandoned amusement park that was once full of joy, only to discover that it has become a shelter for people living on their old memories. Together, they try to bring life back to the place and revive the lost joy.

title: Al khorba
description: The life in a Syrian village with the daily issues of its simple minded poor inhabitants and the continuous conflict between two families for control and recognition

title: Al Kapotnya
description: Petty hooliganism, fights, thefts and their consequences - all this is a routine for employees of the juvenile department. But there is one among them who cares about the chaos reigning in the area. Good cop Pasha is trying his best to save the confused teenagers from prison. But it is very difficult to help those who have gone astray when you are confronted by a local crime boss.

title: Al assifa
description: This drama from Egyptian filmmaker Khaled Youssef offers Western audiences an unusual perspective on the Gulf War, as a family is torn apart by conflicting personal and political allegiances. Hoda (Yousra) is a schoolteacher who became a single mother after her husband, a victim of post-traumatic stress disorder, left his family behind. Ten years later, Hoda has raised her two sons, Aly (Mohamed Nagati) and Nagy (Hani Salama), to young adulthood, and has declined to remarry, despite the presence of her supportive boyfriend Mahmoud (Hisham Selim). Nagy has fallen in love with Hayat (Hanan Turk), a student and political activist from a wealthy family, but her parents don't want her to marry a man without a fortune of his own. As Nagy tries to save enough money to convince Hayat's family he's a worthy husband, Aly decides to help by getting a job to make more money for the family; however, work is hard to come by in Egypt, so he moves to Iraq to take a position there. Once Aly has settled into his new life in Iraq, the war in the Gulf breaks out, and the two brothers discover to their horror that they're fighting in opposing armies -- Aly comes home to swear allegiance to Egypt and join their forces, while Nagy, under the influence of Hayat, has thrown his support behind Iraq. La Tempete, aka Al Assifa received its American premiere at the 2001 San Francisco Film Festival

title: Al-kompars
description: Salem dreams of being an actor but is still working in a gas station, only his love for Nada can make things easier for him.

title: Al Sateh
description: Can one finish building a house they no longer belong to? After reuniting with his family in Ramle, the director puts himself on the scene and navigates this question with no intent of answering it. Instead, he begins to fill the holes in the walls with the fabric of everyday life and the melancholic contemplation of external and internal ruins. A film that stitches together the memories of Nakba in 1948 with the daily continued destruction and persecution of the Palestinian people in movements as slow as the turning of the pages in a photo album.

title: Al Khawaat
description: Three Sisters are kicked out by their father after their mother dies. When they grow up, they face several challenges in work, love, and marriage, and to make matters worse, their father dies, so they have to deal with new obstacles.

title: Al Bawabat Al Sabaa'
description: Al Bawabat Al Sabaa'

title: Al Harafeesh
description: Tensions rise in the house of Suleiman Al-Nagy, the defender of the weak, because his son's wife, Radwana, fell in love with his other son Khider. When Radwana's husband Bark finds out, he accuses his brother of betraying him and tries to kill him but Khider denies the accusation and escapes.

title: I am Hope
description: The first war drama series the Ukrainian TV channel 2+2 which was filmed during a full-scale war in Ukraine. The lead characters are the emergency paramedics, who were rescuing people of their city under continuous shelling and bombing

title: Virgin Am I
description: A sex comedy about a group of teenagers who want to lose their virginity for the first time.

title: I Am Khama!
description: The real BLACK PANTHER. It is 1895. A brilliant African King, whose country is about to be stolen, rushes to England, tours the country, wins the people to his side, blackmails the Colonial Minister and confronts Queen Victoria at Windsor.

title: I Am Kathalan
description: A college student decides to hack into the security system of a company owned by his ex-girlfriend's father.

title: 10 am
description: '10 AM' is a story of the new Indian youth. Where financial freedom is now accompanied by huge self-denials, dramatic lifestyle changes and value system challenges. Which at times is leading to loss of identity. 10 am portrays poignantly the anguish and pain of the new Indian youth caught in a Catch 22 situation. The story is a stark exposition of the social decadence that has set in, into every facet of our day to day to life. The degradation of moral values. The diffusion of human ethos. And finally, cultural atrophy of our psyche is deftly handed in this excellently crafted story. It's the story of a currently on bench (in between jobs situation in software industry) young man, when a sudden crisis puts his well-off family into a financial mess.

title: I Am Weekender
description: Chloé Raunet's insightful documentary about the film 'Weekender' - WIZ's pioneering meditation on the British rave experience set to Flowered Up's song of the same title - which explores its making, impact and legacy.

title: Here I Am
description: 'Here I Am' is driven by three generations of Aboriginal women - Karen Lee Burden, her mother Lois and her daughter Rosie. When Karen is released from prison, through a series of chance encounters the women learn that freedom is hard to find when hearts are still broken.

title: I Am Teppei!
description: Teppei, brought up by his father in the mountains, is an energetic boy who is as tough as weeds and acts as free as a bird. His life changes completely when he enrolls in high school, the first school he has ever attended. Despite his eccentric behavior and being a constant source of troubles, he is soon recognized for his talent in sports-especially in Kendo (the Japanese swordplay art)-and becomes the school's hero.

title: Soccer AM
description: Cult soccer show airing every Saturday morning during the English football season featuring celebrity guests, football challenges and recurring sketches from the cast and crew.

title: Who Am I
description: In one apartment, nine human conditions experience a contained life as they make the world their own.

title: I Am Vengeance
description: A schizophrenic teenage girl attempts to uncover her mysterious path and the murder of her family.

title: Why I Am
description: This film is the first of 5 movies based on true events about an upper-class young man who becomes a heavy criminal after the loss of his mom's high-paying job due to layoffs and his father having to work three jobs and having to move back to the ghetto. He decided to pay his own way no matter what the cost.

title: Who Am I
description: Based on the critically acclaimed novel KO aham By AshokJamnani, The story is set in a small town based on the banks of the river Narmada. Bhavitavya, a philosophy student who is currently living as a tenant at Jyoti's house, is also his girlfriend Aditi's mother. Though the two love each other, their way of life has always differed. While Bhavitva is a curious fellow filled with philosophical questions, Aditi is a cheerful girl who finds joy in even the little things in life. The story takes a turn when Bhavitavya's favourite philosophy professor, Vibhu Laxmi Narayan passes away. The turbulent mind of Bhavitavya starts questioning the existential questions of life. The questions like "Who am I?" or "Ko Aham?" heighten and soon his interaction with an old monk on Narmada Ghat compelled him to embark on a journey of self-discovery Narmada parikrama in the hope to find the answers to his many questions.

title: Ireland: am
description: The early morning news broadcast to Ireland

title: Rudern am limit
description: Swissmocean is the first Swiss team that has set out to cross the Atlantic in a rowing boat.

title: I Am Samuel
description: Filmed verite style over five years, I Am Samuel is an intimate portrait of a Kenyan man torn between balancing duty to his family with his dreams for his future.

title: I Am Mine Alone
description: A refugee Afghan woman flees the Taliban and arrives in Alabama with dreams of a better life and autonomy.

title: Am o idee
description: Some party representatives want to make a new football team. It is supposed to be a comedy.

title: I Am Bone
description: After a gifted boy from 16th Street in Santa Monica is violated by a corrupt police officer and swallowed by the streets, he grows into a feared gang leader known as Bone.

title: I Am 24
description: Subhendu, a middle-aged writer, falls in love with a much younger woman named Sheela. In order to woo her, he pretends to be a younger man.

title: I am Going
description: The idea for the film I Am Going originated on the streets of Paris and at the Cité internationale des arts. A narrative in black and white whose protagonists stand facing one another to proclaim nothing less than the end of the world. Two women gifted with political acumen and common sense, whose interpretations go unheard nevertheless. Their revelations are articulated on a sort of pilgrimage that leads each of them to find the other. The journey takes them from the country to the city, from the city back to the country and directly through the city itself. It is the pose, the gesture in public space, like a raised fist, a scarf held in a hand, or public graffiti, that weighs on the characters' shoulders and grows heavier by going unnoticed.

title: I Am Banni
description: "I Am Banni" is a Hindi feature film Produced by Mr. Anil Garg along with Rahul and Gaurav Garg of RG Movies production and Directed by Nitin Chaudhary and K.K. Makwana. Promoting the social cause "Beti Bachao, Beti Padhao", I am Banni features Actress Roshni Walia, Gaurav Garg, Harjinder Singh, Amanda Rodario and Vikas Shrivastav in the lead role. Shot in Bhuj and across the grandeur of the Rann of Kutch, "I am Banni" highlights the struggles of a young girl who wants to study and also enables other girls of her conservative village to be allowed to study. The movie aims at educating the audience that even in 2018 there is an appalling amount of girls who are not allowed to study due to the archaic rules of our society.

title: I Am 24
description: Subhendu, a middle-aged writer, falls in love with a much younger woman named Sheela. In order to woo her, he pretends to be a younger man.

title: I am Watching You
description: A crime factual drama that captures the other side of the crime such as CCTV footage, black box videos, social media posts, and cell phone videos that someone filmed, from multiple perspectives. It looks at crime realistically through the eyes of society rather than from the perspective of victims and perpetrators.

title: 8:28 am
description: A married woman runs a successful gallery and falls for a man she met accidentally.

title: Mississippi I Am
description: In 2006, 'NSync's Lance Bass came out publicly as gay. Once the "most beloved son" of his home state of Mississippi, he was instantly rejected and his hopes that Mississippi could ever embrace change were dashed. Then in 2010 he heard the story of Constance McMillen, 18, who was suing her school for denying her the right to go to the prom with her girlfriend. Something was shifting even in the most socially conservative states in America. MISSISSIPPI: I AM, examines the relatively new battle on the part of primarily young LGBT people to bring gay civil rights and visibility out in the open and beyond division.

title: Am Aha
description: Kalyan and his friends are prime suspects in a murder case and are asked to pay 20 lakhs as bribe by the corrupted CI. They only have 24 hours to clear their names. Will it work out?

title: I Am Happy
description: Park Seo Yoon's family is very successful but Seo Yoon does not flaunt her wealth around. Instead she pretends that she's an ordinary girl and not a spoiled rich girl. She works really hard to get into her father's company so that other co-workers will see that she worked her way to the top instead of getting help from her daddy. She dates Lee Joon Soo and doesn't tell him that she comes from a wealthy family, not even when he wants to meet her family.

title: What Am I
description: 'What Am I' is a film about a man who after a string of heart breaks and failed relationships decides he will shut himself off emotionally from women. To fill the void, however, that being in a relationship fulfills, he decides to become a photographer of women, adapting an alter ego, a project hidden from his family and friends. But one of his biggest fans soon complicates his world when she joins him on a few shoots, and he finds that he must ultimately choose who exactly he wants to be, lest the decision is made for him.

title: I Am Mother
description: In the wake of humanity's extinction, a teenage girl is raised by a robot designed to repopulate the earth. But their unique bond is threatened when an inexplicable stranger arrives with alarming news.

title: I Am Human
description: Meet the world's first 'cyborgs' - a quadriplegic, a blind man, an amputee, a bio-hacker, and a woman with Parkinson's - the scientists who help them, and one entrepreneur who will stop at nothing on his quest to unlock the brain.

title: Am Sgula
description: Am Sgula is an Israeli comedy show that aired on Keshet's Channel 2 in 2011, starring members of the Ma Kashur trio - actors Tzion Baruch , Asi Israelof and Shalom Michaelshwilli. The program comically presents various Israelis who come abroad or are related to traveling around the world. Some of the episodes were filmed in India and Thailand.

title: I Am a Man
description: Set in Nebraska in 1879, the film will tell the dramatic and inspirational story of Ponca Chief Standing Bear, who, after experiencing decades of maltreatment and disenfranchisement, successfully argued in U.S. District Court in Omaha that Native Americans are "persons within the meaning of the law", thus becoming the first Native American judicially granted civil rights under American law.

title: I AM New
description: Sometimes life takes the wind out of us causing us to fall, so we have to find new ways to fly. This series explores the lives of eight different individuals as they recover from very different traumatic circumstances.

title: Am fost 16
description: The heroic march of the Romanian Army to conquer Budapest once more. Everybody is saved and treated well by the Romanians.

title: I am Sam
description: There are some offers that you just can't refuse. Jang Yi San (Yang Dong Geun) is a rookie teacher who is put in charge of a homeroom full of misfits and troublemakers, including Chae Moo Shin (T.O.P) and Yoo Eun Byul (Park Min Young). Eun Byul happens to be the daughter of Yoo Jae Gon (Park Joon Gyu), the head of a dangerous gangster organization. When Jae Gon realizes that Yi San can make his only daughter actually interested in studying, he makes the teacher an offer that he can't refuse: become Eun Byul's private tutor in exchange for one million won.

title: Mord am Montag
description: Monika Stangel, a prostitute who is in the middle of a big fraud, is murdered in her apartment. The Laube police inspector quickly finds many leads to the perpetrators of the murder, but everything is tangled up due to lies and false testimonies.

title: I Am Innocent
description: A young captain of the French artillery is wrongfully accused of treason. He is tried and sentenced to life in prison, while a group of people try to expose those behind the sinister conspiracy.

title: Who Am I?
description: A film about Jasper's exploration into the nature of self, consciousness, and reality.

title: An Accidental Fire
description: Set in present-day in the historic city of Philadelphia and inspired by real-life recent events, the premise of An Accidental Fire is a microcosm for our world's increasing societal discord. An Accidental Fire follows the story of an unlikely trio of heroes through their daring escape from a recommissioned prison. It follows them down the rabbit hole into which they they find themselves falling. Simultaneously, AAF tells the tale of a group of treacherous villains who pose as much of a danger to each other as they do to the heroes. Troy Hudson Jr., a hopeful and idealistic schoolteacher, is arrested while leading a protest and taken to a recommissioned prison facility. He quickly learns an unimaginable truth: he has only three days to escape before he and the other detainees are to be disappeared forever. A covert operative, Helen, goes on a personal mission to help Troy escape. With the help of her covert group, The Shadows, she connects with the stoic Officer William Ridley to help Troy and the imprisoned children to escape. Enter the villains, the sociopathic Captain Erin Clark, her submissive minion Officer Dennis Chandler, and Government One Intelligence Agent Darius Whitaker. Following the heroes' prison escape, a manhunt ensues. While Troy, Helen, and Ridley, work to stay hidden, they begin to uncover not just Captain Clark's secrets - including her past connection with Troy and his family - but also, they begin to crack the shell of secrets that surround Agent Darius Whitaker and the secret global cabal that employs him, Government One (G-1). Working together, the ensemble races against the clock to expose the secrets of devious, manipulative Captain Clark to show the world who she really is and to escape the lethal hunters set on them by G-1 before it's too late for them, and for the world as they know it.

title: An Extinction
description:
It starts with an extensively drug resistant strain of TB in Western Australia, and total extinction of all human, animal, plant, and bacterial life on the planet. Only the birds remain. The birds, and a few bedraggled and starving survivors. Some are the lucky ones who survived their infection. Others are the resourceful ones who managed to avoid the airborne Red11 infection altogether.

Aoife and Niamh are two of the latter, sisters who live on in post-apocalyptic Ireland, having avoided the disease altogether through reclusiveness, caution, and luck. They spend their days trawling the Irish countryside for anything that will help keep them alive, staying one foot ahead of starvation and infection, not daring to approach the lawless anarchy of the big towns and cities that are left. At night they retreat to their base, a small house deep in the wilderness, where they read, play board games, and remember the past.

Their routine is turned upside down when they encounter an intruder, a desperate loner trying to outrun a group he calls 'The Lost Boys'. Knowing the danger he poses them as the only other person who knows the location of their house, the girls cannot let him go. They consider what they should do with him in grim conversation, and end up holding him as a prisoner. He speaks of a rumored town out west near Galway, the town of New Hope, where people have come together and civilization has started again. When The Lost Boys catch up with them the girls are forced to flee their last refuge and take off on a desperate and deadly journey across the barren country in the pursuit of New Hope...

Sir says it was just a lie and he was making a film's script, all people goes and leaves the place....

description: TUDO POR AMOR AO CINEMA (All For the Love of the Movies) is a documentary film about one of the most important characters in the history of Brazilian cinematography: COSME ALVES NETTO (1937 1996), better known as COSME from the Museum of Modern Arts Cinematheque MAMRJ. Cosme, for over five decades, took an active part in many events in the history of Latin American film making, especially in that which dealt with the divulgation and preservation of films.

title: [dublado] Voltar ao Passado: Amor Eterno
description: Na vida passada, Estela Prado se casou com o pobre Marcelo Costa e, contra todas as expectativas, tornou-se uma dama da alta sociedade. Já sua irmã mais jovem Bianca Prado, que se casou com o oficial Leonardo Almeida, enlouqueceu após a morte repentina do marido logo após o casamento. Bianca acabou tirando a vida de Estela, mas foi morta por ela em retaliação — e ambas reencarnaram.

title: Fernanda Young: Foge-me ao Controle
description: Poetic documentary essay about the writer, presenter and screenwriter Fernanda Young.

title: De Volta ao Topo
description: Yang Tian, o Lorde do Palácio da Supressão do Dragão, foi amaldiçoado e caiu em coma pouco antes de seu casamento. Por dez anos, sua esposa, Jiang Wanying, permaneceu firme, nunca deixando seu lado. Ela trabalhou incansavelmente, dia e noite, para mantê-lo vivo. Após uma década, Yang Tian finalmente desperta. Para compensar os dez anos de sofrimento que Jiang Wanying enfrentou, ele convida poderosas famílias de todos os cantos do mundo para organizar um grande banquete de casamento em sua homenagem.

title: De Volta Ao Jogo
description:
A mãe solteira Mariana terminou com seu primeiro amor, Luis, há oito anos... Mas nunca contou a ele que estava grávida! Agora ele e uma estrela nacional do futebol
 e chefe de Mariana! De repente, juntos novamente, será que Mariana contará a verdade ou é tarde demais para um final feliz?

title: Predestinado ao Meu Rival Alfa
description: Os rivais Kane e Quinn são escolhidos pela Deusa da Lua, unidos por um laço que arde quando estão separados. Quinn abre mão do posto de Alfa para salvar Kane. Expostos por Cyrus, eles juram viver e morrer juntos, tomam a coroa e anulam a lei da companheira loba. Varg, da Bloodfang, ataca; Quinn é capturado e descobre que Varg destruiu sua família. Na Lua de Sangue, os dois se recusam a matar um ao outro, despertam o poder dos reis gêmeos, e Varg e Cyrus morrem. Eles coroam um ao outro e adotam Pup.

title: Destinado ao Alfa do Meu Irmão
description: Luca Conri é o nanico sem lobo da Alcateia Nightreign, o típico cão que ladra não morde. Atormentado pela própria alcateia e caçado por rivais, Luca é relutantemente colocado sob a proteção de Dalton, seu Alfa dominante e melhor amigo do seu irmão mais velho. No entanto, tudo muda quando os dois se tornam companheiros destinados, um vínculo que viola a ordem natural da alcateia. Com inimigos cercando e tradições tentando separá-los, Luca e Dalton precisam decidir se vão ceder ao desejo em um romance proibido que ameaça suas próprias vidas.

title: Atada ao Alfa Amaldiçoado
description: Após ser traída e humilhada publicamente na Cerimônia Real de Casamento, o Rei Alfa amaldiçoado a reivindica como sua Luna para sobreviver à Lua de Sangue desta noite. Mas ela é secretamente sua verdadeira alma gêmea, a princesa perdida de Moonveil, e a única mulher cujo vínculo pode conter a besta dentro dele antes que a maldição se rompa de vez.

title: Vinculada ao Príncipe Dragão Errado
description: Zara ama o Príncipe Jasper há anos e sonha em se tornar sua Rainha. Mas, quando seu ritual de vínculo dá errado, ela se vê magicamente vinculada ao irmão mais velho dele, o exilado Príncipe Dragão Caspian. Ainda determinada a conquistar Jasper, Zara pede a Caspian que lhe ensine os segredos do romance. Porém, o vínculo proibido entre eles torna cada vez mais difícil lembrar qual príncipe ela realmente deseja.

title: [dublado] Amor ao Primeiro Voo
description: O bilionário Gabriel Neves foi confundido com um funcionário de terra ao embarcar num avião da sua própria companhia aérea. Durante o voo, ajudou a chefe de cabine Alexa Lima quando ela foi assediada. Após a aterragem, Gabriel concordou em fingir ser o namorado de Alexa para a ajudar, mas isso levou a um mal-entendido com o seu filho Caio. Gabriel e Alexa uniram forças para resolver os problemas familiares dele e uma crise na empresa, mas Gabriel teve de enfrentar uma última prova para poder casar-se com Alexa.

title: Ao Som do Chamamé
description: Ao Som do Chamamé is a documentary that tells the story and origins of the Chamamé music. A folkloric musical style born in the triple border between Brazil, Argentina and Paraguay in the beginning of the 20th century. Shot in Argentina and Brazil and Paraguay. Spoken in Portuguese and Spanish.

title: Destinada ao meu Alfa Proibido
description: Selena cresceu órfã e desprotegida na alcateia da Lua de Sangue. Seu único sonho é completar dezoito anos e fugir de seus abusadores. Mas a Deusa Lua tinha outros planos para ela, e logo Selena descobre que sua alma gêmea é Jacobo, Alfa da alcateia Lua de Sangue, o mesmo homem que ela odeia e de quem quer fugir... ou será ele o escolhido? O que acontece quando outro Alfa também afirma ser sua alma gêmea?

title: O vampiro da porta ao lado
description: O introvertido Cameron é apaixonado por Diane, do colégio. Seus planos amorosos são interrompidos quando a vampira Victoria se muda para a casa ao lado. Logo, Cameron se vê numa aventura de vida ou morte.

title: Viagem ao Fim do Mundo
description: During a flight, passengers confront their aspirations, frustrations, fears, wishes and fears, mixing up reality and fiction.

title: Do Inimigo ao Marido Fiel
description: O playboy Saulo Alves quer se vingar de sua inimiga de infância Luna Ferreira, que é mestra em medicina e artes marciais. Ele gasta quatro mil reais para se casar com ela, planejando atormentá-la depois do casamento. Mas acaba caindo na própria armadilha. Desde então, a rotina de Saulo mudou completamente: durante o dia, é espetado com agulhas de acupuntura; à noite, é punido por quebrar as regras. O antigo rei da bagunça se tornou, finalmente, o cachorro fiel exclusivo de sua esposa。

title: Gang ao chuan qi
description: A fascinating comedy of amorous complications and modern morals: The two cities are Macau, where a love quartet is the source for sexy merriment, and Hong Kong, where a gambler tells a charming woman why there are four shackles hanging from his apartment ceiling.

title: S.O.S.: Mulheres ao Mar 2
description: Afraid her husband will fall back with his ex girlfriend after they're assigned to work together, Adriana and her sister set sail to the U.S. to go after him to stop this from happening.

title: Amor ao Primeiro Voo
description: O bilionário Gabriel Neves foi confundido com um funcionário de terra ao embarcar num avião da sua própria companhia aérea. Durante o voo, ajudou a chefe de cabine Alexa Lima quando ela foi assediada. Após a aterragem, Gabriel concordou em fingir ser o namorado de Alexa para a ajudar, mas isso levou a um mal-entendido com o seu filho Caio. Gabriel e Alexa uniram forças para resolver os problemas familiares dele e uma crise na empresa, mas Gabriel teve de enfrentar uma última prova para poder casar-se com Alexa.

title: Destinada ao Alfa Proibido
description: Selene cresceu órfã e negligenciada na alcateia da Lua de Sangue. Seu único sonho é completar dezoito anos e fugir de seus abusadores. Mas a Deusa da Lua acima tinha outros planos para ela, e logo Selene descobre que seu companheiro é o Alpha Jackson da Lua de Sangue, o próprio homem que ela odeia e quer fugir... ou ele é o único? O que acontece quando outro Alpha também afirma ser seu companheiro?!

title: Sou Igual ao Amanhecer [Doblado]
description: Amanhe Martins teve seu dia de efetivação transformado em demissão. No mesmo turbilhão, um encontro inesperado com Rafael Moura reescreveu seu destino. Por indicação dele, Amanhe agarrou uma oportunidade na elite das consultorias, a Maxwell. Com resiliência extraordinária, não só se firmou como evoluiu de novata a uma analista senhora de suas funções. Nos cruzamentos profissionais, um afeto sutil nasceu entre ambos, unindo-os. Por trás da imagem impecável de Rafael, escondia-se um medo do amor e uma dificuldade em expressá-lo. Amanhe, com sua empatia e otimismo, curou-o com paciência e doçura, abrindo-lhe, pouco a pouco, as portas do coração. Rafael começou então a desfazer a carapaça fria, aprendendo a relaxar, a aceitar suas imperfeições e a descobrir como expressar amor.

title: Over the Edge
description: Over the Edge

title: Blue Exorcist
description: After discovering that he's the son of Satan, a young man must join the True Cross Academy in order to master his abilities and defeat Satan himself.

title: Render-se ao meu Professor
description: A estudante universitária Sylvia Parker se vê em um perigoso caso de amor com Lawrence Calhoun, o último homem que ela deveria querer. Ele é gato, durão - e é seu professor. Enquanto Sylvia luta para sobreviver em um campus cruel e em uma família tóxica, ela nunca pensou que seu herói seria o frio, rigoroso e sexy professor Calhoun. À medida que a conexão se aprofunda, um romance proibido floresce, ameaçando destruir tudo se for descoberto.

title: Minha Sogra Feroz Me Leva ao Topo
description:
Nácia Diniz era uma jovem trabalhadora moderna, até reencarnar como uma personagem vaidosa e sem juízo em uma história de época pobre.
No enredo original, ela perde o noivo para uma mulher mais velha e, revoltada, casa-se com Caíque Batista, irmão do protagonista e ex-militar. Mas ela despreza o marido, se envolve com o irmão dele e acaba se divorciando. Anos depois, fica desfigurada e morre pobre, enquanto Caíque se torna um poderoso empresário.
Ao reencarnar, Nácia decide mudar seu destino: abandona o comportamento antigo, trata Caíque e a sogra com carinho e acaba encontrando um amor inesperado.

title: De Volta ao Meu Ex-Marido com Nossos Gêmeos Gênios
description: Há seis anos, ela partiu depois de um evento que quase lhe custou a vida. Agora, voltando com seu filho, ela encontrou alguém do seu passado em um leilão, mas parecia que ela tinha completamente esquecido dele...

title: Deixem-me ao Menos Subir às Palmeiras
description: Rape by an African foreman leads to the the mounting revolt of the labour force in an African colony. While some are forced to accept their condition of slaves, others prepare themselves to fight back at the armed repression.

title: As Gouda as it Gets
description: Artisan cheese shop owner Brie finds herself competing for a $50,000 prize in her town's annual Cheese Festival. To boost her presence, she teams up with an influential cheese critic to profile her vintage smoked gouda. As their friendship develops into romance, a competitor's business proposal and unforeseen complications force Brie to put her shop - and heart - on the line.

title: As Worlds Collide
description: MI6 secret agent William Hastings is on a mission pursuing terrorists in France. He uncovers a plot to build backpack sized nuclear warheads for an American billionaire who wants to start World War III.

title: As Good as Bread
description: Lisette (Carmen Russo) is a high-priced call-girl, that entertains her eccentric clients in her apartment and in empty theaters over opera. She meets a bumbling astronomer Filippo (Saverio Marconi), and after a series of mishaps, they got married.

title: Death as Life
description: Shhh! Death is a taboo subject. Most of us do not want to discuss it. We tiptoe around it, try to circumvent it, or use euphemisms. Our loved ones did not die; they 'passed away'. Maybe we think we can avoid death, but no one can, and death is not limited to physical death. It comes in many forms. We can experience the death of a dream, the death of a relationship, the death of our youth, the death of our health, and any number of significant changes that force us to grapple with impermanence. If we do not face death, though, we fear it, and fear is an even heavier load to bear than death, because fear saps the energy out of life.

title: Do As I Say, Not As I Do.
description: A degenerate father wins a ton of money off lottery scratchers while having outstanding child support payments, causing him problems cashing the winning tickets.

title: True As Steel
description: Frank Parry, a prosperous middle-aged manufacturer, takes a business trip to New York, where he becomes infatuated with Eva Boutelle, manager of the Swansea Cotton Mills. For a time, their affair develops, but Eva remains true to her husband and rejects Frank's suggestion that they divorce their spouses and marry each other. Frank returns home; receives his wife's forgiveness; and finds that his daughter, Ethel, is determined to enter the business world.

title: As Promised
description: 'As Promised' is a delightful suspense drama. The film revolves around a young woman who is trying to make ends meet in the big city and receives anonymous emails, offering her money for certain deaths taking place in the city.

title: As White as in Snow
description: Inspired by real-life Elsa Andersson, this mostly fictional movie tells the story of her upbringing as a farmer's daughter, in the early 1900s, who dreams of getting away from the farm and becoming an aviatrix.

title: As Cool as I Am
description: A smart teenage girl comes of age in a small town with her self-centered parents who had her when they were teenagers.

title: Simple as Water
description: A meditation on the elemental bonds of family told through portraits of four Syrian families in the aftermath of war.

title: As Ye Sow
description: Dora, the daughter of a wealthy man, marries a good-looking young fellow from the country who has made an auspicious start in New York business life. Having won the girl by trickery, he proceeds to reveal a baseness of disposition that makes his young wife's life a terrible burden. He becomes a drunkard who abuses his wife and baby. Dora resents his cruelty and he robs her of the child, surreptitiously conveying it to his mother, then going away to sea on a fishing schooner. Bereft of husband and child, Dora falls prey to grief. Fresh suffering awaits her when news comes that her vicious young husband was drowned at sea. Concealing her identity, she makes her way to the fishing village where her husband was born, becomes his mother's paying guest, recognizes her child, and inspires the love of her husband's brother, now a clergyman. Dora's troubles are about to recommence with undiminished severity. Her husband married her under a false name, so she is in ignorance of his relatives, and in this state of ignorance she lends a willing ear to the wooing of the Rev. John St. John, her late husband's brother. The wedding ceremony is about to take place when a storm at sea arises, a ship in distress is sighted, there is a call to man the life-boat, and Dora's fiancé volunteers. Among the rescued is Dora's legal husband Frank, who re-asserts his claim to wife and child, grows jealous of his brother, and once more becomes a drunkard. One of his New York reprobate companions appears to demand money. There is a quarrel and both men are killed. The sinful man has reaped as he sowed, and like so many of his kind has made others suffer for his misdeeds, particularly the fond girl who married him.

title: El as negro
description: This is the story of a convict fellow whose brother is a bright scientist that discovers a vaccine against a deadly infection. The clash between good and evil moves the convict to search into his soul and find the goodness that will lead him to the ultimate sacrifice.

title: As Good As You
description: A serious comedy about grief.

title: Running as One
description: Running As One follows First Nations band leader Errol Ranville as he works some hot new talent into his band. It combines multi camera concert footage, interviews and archival footage to provide a portrait of a musical legend.

title: As Canalhas
description: Anthology series in which each episode depicts a different woman confiding her misadventures and dirty deeds to her hair stylist.

title: As Evil Does
description: When a door-to-door Evangelist unknowingly enters the home of an atheist, their deepest fears are confronted and all hell breaks loose.

title: Cool as Hell
description: When a friendly demon helps two guys to meet girls, the portal to hell also lets in a more evil creature that starts terrorizing the town.

title: Hard as Nails
description: Unordained evangelical minister Justin Fatica and his Hard As Nails Ministry promote the gospel to all Christian faiths and reach out to the MTV generation.

title: Vreemder as Fiksie
description: A documentary style show that delves into the stories of ordinary people who's lives have been turned upside down by bizarre events or dark secrets that have come to light.

title: As It Flows
description: Satomi, who quit her job, runs a grocery store run by her older sister, and meets a man waiting for her lover in front of the store. The two accidentally leave the store and talk while walking through the streets of Tokyo. Without knowing whether it is true that they are talking to each other, the two are slowly dragged along... .

title: [dublado] As palavras
description: Há quatro anos, o roqueiro rebelde Phoenix partiu o coração da nerd certinha Lennon e roubou sua música para escapar do pai abusivo. Agora, ele é um astro do rock famoso, mergulhado nas drogas e no álcool, e ela é contratada para manter ele sóbrio por oito semanas durante uma turnê. Será que Lennon e Phoenix conseguirão curar as feridas do passado, ou ele impedirá uma segunda chance para o amor?

title: As Perennial as the Grass
description: An old house serves as the vessel for a never-ending cycle of insanity and tragedy...a twisted familial love that becomes a treacherous cage again and again...and again.

title: As Green As It Gets
description: Georg "Schorsch" Kempter is a gardener in a small Bavarian town. When the owner of the local golf course tries to cheat Schorsch for his money, he grabs the control stick and flies away in an attempt to save his plane and himself.

title: As Mine
description: Two college students fall in love when they discover their mutual admiration for the band Mint Condition. After witnessing a hate crime, the couple's love is put to the test as they begin to discover the immense cultural and social realities that divide them.

title: Never Again as Before
description: Four boys and two girls who have just graduated from high school vacation together in the heart-stopping Dolomite mountains. On a dramatic climbing expedition up a mystic peak, they encounter a tragedy that will change each of them forever.

title: Thick as Thieves
description: Tough City - where grifters, dips and shysters scramble for a dirty dollar and a clean shirt - where one man stands head and shoulders beneath the rest - Al Hacker - small time pickpocket - master bungler. Only Lisa, his curvaceous sister and partner-in-crime, stand between Al and disaster.

title: Good as Gold
description: When Buck Brady is a child, his father's mine is stolen, and he grows up planning to revenge the injustice. He finally retaliates by holding up the mine's payroll messengers. He falls in love with Janet Laurier, later learns that she is the owner of the mine, then saves her from the crooked foreman Tilford and fights him on a moving car that finally falls off the edge of a cliff.

title: As Meninas
description: Inspired in Lygia Fagundes Telles's famous book, the film follows three very different girls (Lorena, Lia and Ana Clara) living in a boarding house during some of the most repressive moments of Brazil's military dictatorship in 1972.

title: Good as You
description: Protested by Catholic organizations at the time of its release, this romantic comedy from Italy follows eight characters who cross paths on New Year's Eve in Rome. After a sudden power outage, the night takes a strange turn and our eight separate protagonists are well on their way to becoming four distinct couples.

title: Sweet as Pie
description: Tamara visits her family's apple orchard in hopes of taking a break from life. She begins to fall for her childhood best friend and now the farm manager, Will, and together they go to great lengths to keep the orchard alive.

title: Life as a Movie
description: Comedic host and pro surfer, Benji Weatherley, takes the worlds biggest names in surf, skate and snow and one very famous musician around the world to experience each others sports first hand. From the exotic island of Kandui in the Mentawaiis for world class surfing to the concrete jungle of Japan for indoor snowboarding, surfing a man made wave pool and skating the streets of Osaka, to the majestic white caps of Whistler for insane powder moments. Traditionally, these pro athletes are presented solely within their individual sport. However, there is a common thread among these professions that unite them. Though surfing, skateboarding and snowboarding are all very different, they are all part of a revolution of sports called Action Sports. "Life as a Movie" explores this commonality in a cinematic and realistic manner as viewers get an up close and personal look into what actually goes into being a professional action sports athlete. Despite the differences these athletes may have, they are all part of an elite group of professionals that has forever changed sports history.

title: Life at GJCC
description: This reality series follows the lives of students at Gulfport Job Corps Center, as they go through their daily lives each episode follows some new people and sometimes you may catch them having fun and some days you may see how their school life is and how and what they do after school.

title: At Hell's Door
description: In less than ten hours, at 06:22 precisely, Halley's comet will strike the Earth, ending all life in the small community of a Greek island. Now, the village's priest has a mission from God to accomplish; but, can hatred turn into love?

title: Ralph at Emilio
description:
It’s Fri-YAY kaya itaas ang energy para ma-manifest ang positivity! Itinaas din ni Pop Pristine Marielle Montellano ang pagbirit, na kay sarap naman talagang pakinggan. Kaya si Vice Ganda, hindi naiwasang humanga!

Huwag matakot tumalak and let your voice be heard, katulad ng mga kandidata na hindi sumuko kahit bigo man no’ng una. Now they’re back, louder and wittier, sa Resbakulawan round ng Miss Q and A sa “It’s Showtime.”

Na-miss ng sangkabaklaan sina Agua, Elise Kagandahan, at Carla Flores Argonza, kaya pati ang trio nina Vice Ganda, Lassy at MC ay hindi matapos-tapos ang kulitan with the candidates. Miss Q and A pa ba o comedy club?

Pero hindi comedy, dahil seryoso’t malaman ang mga chukchak ng mga rumeres-baks.

Ang Top 2 na sina Agua at Carla ang nag-face off sa Beklamation kung saan pareho nilang hinarap ang tanong na, “Kung may pagkakataon at oportunidad, mangingibang-bayan ka ba o mananatili ka pa rin sa Pilipinas?”

Pareho ang nilalaman ng kanilang puso, oo, mananatili sila sa bansang ito. Ngunit sa huli, may isang mas umangat sa talakan. Sa Day 5 ng Resbakulawan, si Carla ang kinoronahan.

Break muna sa quiz at recitation sa classroom ang mga college students ng Caloocan, dahil sa Laro Laro Pick game arena muna ang exam nila.

Fun ang kuwentuhan nina Vice Ganda, Bianca Umali, at Amy Perez kay player Wawang, na super inspired sa young love, sweet love na pag-iibigan nila ni Princess.

At naki-join pa si Bianca sa mga makukulit na Act-Song eksena sa You Gotta Lyric round. At sa pagpapatuloy ng kuwento ni Memerimar, nagpakilala na si Ion Perez bilang Alejandro.

Ang top-notcher sa laro ay walang iba kundi si player Lea, na tinanggihan ang P25,000. Sa bilis niyang mag-solve ng Math problem, sa kanya ang P125,000 POT money!

title: Joue au Patron Si Tu l'Oses
description: Après avoir été injustement accusée de coucher avec son patron et licenciée, Olivia décroche un nouvel emploi chez Wilder Conglomerate, où elle réalise que son nouveau patron n'est autre que Theo Wilder, l'homme avec qui elle a passé la nuit précédente ! Olivia affirme qu'ils ne peuvent pas travailler ensemble, mais Theo la met au défi de rester et de relever un pari : il affirme qu'il peut la faire tomber amoureuse de lui, tandis qu'Olivia est persuadée qu'elle pourra résister à son charme... Mais combien de temps pourra-t-elle tenir face aux avances de son patron ?

title: [Doublé] Quatre cadeaux d'adieu au parrain Faucon 2
description:
Aurélie Roux est le cerveau du clan Faucon, une stratège brillante qui gère une grande partie de leurs affaires légales. Lorsqu’elle décide soudainement de rendre tous les comptes et de couper les liens avec le clan, son protégé ne comprend pas pourquoi celle qu’il considère comme leur avenir choisit de partir.

Ce qu’il ignore, c’est qu’Aurélie est mariée secrètement depuis trois ans à Victor Faucon, le parrain du clan. Elle lui a consacré sa beauté, son intelligence et sa loyauté, espérant un jour gagner son amour. Mais une fusillade sur les quais va tout changer. Gravement blessée par treize balles, elle tente désespérément de joindre Victor pour obtenir l’aide du chirurgien du clan. Lorsqu’il répond enfin, elle entend seulement Karine Romain, l’ancienne meilleure amie d’Aurélie et l’amour passé de Victor, lui demander de venir à son anniversaire.

Aurélie survit seule, rejoint la clinique du clan et attend une opération. Mais lorsque Victor arrive avec Karine blessée à la cheville, il choisit de faire passer Karine avant elle et retire son chirurgien du bloc. Privée de soins à temps, Aurélie tombe gravement malade et lutte entre la vie et la mort pendant une semaine.

À son réveil, elle comprend que Victor ne l’a jamais aimée : leur mariage n’était qu’un moyen de préserver sa réputation après un scandale et de profiter de ses talents. Héritière secrète du puissant clan Roux, Aurélie décide alors de reprendre son pouvoir. Elle prépare sa vengeance, offre quatre cadeaux d’adieu destinés à provoquer leur chute, puis disparaît définitivement de la vie de Victor.

title: The Dream Makers
description: Zhou Wei Yun (Zoe Tay), Head of Variety, is thrilled when her boyfriend, Zhi Ming (Desmond Shen), leaves a message saying he can have lunch with her on Valentine's Day. Zhu Kang Li (Li Ping Chen) is the Senior VP of the Drama Unit. She is married to a plastic surgeon, Jian Guo (Liang Guo), and they have a son, Naonao (Alston Yeo). Reminding Jian Guo about Valentine's dinner, Kang Li orders the maid to return by 5pm to take care of Naonao. Fei Er (Jeanette Aw) is a junior artiste at the television station and her boyfriend, Jason (Yuwu Qi), is an ad director. She worries about his habit of changing his mind and annoying the producer. When given a role with more lines, she is pleased. Kang Li takes the bus with Naonao and sees Fei Er with Jason. Fei Er pretends not to see her when Naonao creates a din. In the make-up room, Fei Er is ignored by the staff. The popular Xie Liu Xin (Dawn Yeoh) turns up, and everyone fusses over her. title: Rescue 995
description: Shi Hao Ran (Jeanette Aw) and Xu Wen Qian (Yvonne Lim) get acquainted on their first day of work with the ambulance unit after they save a woman suffering from appendicitis and a young man from head injury. Hao Ran's father is a famous cardiologist who hopes for her to be a doctor, but she chooses to work as an ambulance medic. A young Wen Qian witnessed the ambulance crew's relentless effort to save her mother and henceforth aspired to be one. Hao Ran's brother, Zhe Ming (Pierre Png), is a doctor at the emergency unit and likes Wen Qian. Huang Yi Xun (Ping Hui Tay) joins the ambulance unit and sees it as yet another job, incurring the dislike of Hao Ran. She changes her mind when she realizes that he is kindhearted and takes good care of old folks. On a daily basis, the ambulance crew is faced with many cases, while some appreciates their work, others vent their anger on them. This fast-paced drama follows the dedicated ambulance crew about their daily life and witnesses the split-second decisions they have to make to save a life.
