title: A Light Sleep
description:
Sixteen-year-old Yeo Lin used to have a boyfriend and normal life, but everything changed when she lost both her parents two years ago. To support her siblings, she sells her body. Quietly bearing wounds and responsibilities beyond her age, she faces the cruel trials of love, friendship, and premature adulthood, and she does it all in seeming detachment. Always tired, Yeo Lin suffers from chronic insomnia and relies on medication to sleep. For Yeo Lin, sleep is an escape that she wakes from too soon.

Directed by Lim Seong-chan, the 2008 indie drama A Light Sleep sensitively depicts the ordeals faced by an insomniac high school girl forced to grow up too soon. Teenaged newcomer Choi Ah-jin delivers a mature and compelling performance in the leading role. The film co-stars Yoon Chan and Hong Ah-reum

title: Like an Actress
description: Anna and Antoine are the perfect tandem on stage and in life, but after many years of marriage and working together, they begin to lose interest in each other. title: Yong an Dream
description: Yong an, the capital city, fell into chaos due to the collapse of the West Canal. Wenqi Shen, the Minister of Works in charge of the construction, was implicated overnight and thrown into prison. "When the nest is overturned, no egg remains intact." Wenqi Shen's two daughters, Ran Shen and Zhen Shen, found themselves trapped in a dilemma one after another. Especially Zhen Shen, the youngest daughter, who had always been sheltered in seclusion and was ignorant of the world, now struggled to fend for herself on the streets. During this time, Shiyan Lu, the imperial prosecutor responsible for investigating the case, was perplexed by recurring dreams of his entanglement with a mysterious woman. After verification, he discovered that the mysterious woman in his dreams was Zhen Shen, the daughter of the guilty official. Shiyan Lu gradually approached her, stepping into an unknown fate. As they delved into the West Canal case, they experienced life and death, entrusted each other with faith, and developed a deep affection. With Zhen Shen's help, Shiyan Lu uncovered the truth behind the case. However, the true mastermind was silently closing in on the two of them.

title: Do Demitido ao Temido: Jamais ao Seu Alcance (Dublado)
description: Para cumprir um acordo de noivado, Armando entra no Grupo Almeida e ajuda secretamente Danila a se destacar como empresária. Em troca, recebe desprezo e humilhações. Ferido, ele pede demissão, rompe o noivado e desaparece. Logo, sua verdadeira identidade é revelada: ele é o herdeiro do Grupo Medeiros. Com sua saída, o Grupo Almeida colapsa, e Danila percebe tarde demais o valor do homem que perdeu.

title: Sou Igual ao Amanhecer
description: Amanhe Martins teve seu dia de efetivação transformado em demissão. No mesmo turbilhão, um encontro inesperado com Rafael Moura reescreveu seu destino. Por indicação dele, Amanhe agarrou uma oportunidade na elite das consultorias, a Maxwell. Com resiliência extraordinária, não só se firmou como evoluiu de novata a uma analista senhora de suas funções. Nos cruzamentos profissionais, um afeto sutil nasceu entre ambos, unindo-os. Por trás da imagem impecável de Rafael, escondia-se um medo do amor e uma dificuldade em expressá-lo. Amanhe, com sua empatia e otimismo, curou-o com paciência e doçura, abrindo-lhe, pouco a pouco, as portas do coração. Rafael começou então a desfazer a carapaça fria, aprendendo a relaxar, a aceitar suas imperfeições e a descobrir como expressar amor.

One is the station chief, who lost his eye and the other foot on the front, and the other was left with caries, and the other was the wife of the station chief.

title: As You Were
description: Oh, those Army daze and nights! An infusion of WAC beauties adds to the fun when ex-G.I. "Dodo" Doubleday (William Tracy), now a hotel clerk, impresses Army brass with his memory and considers going back into the military. But recruiting station sergeant Bill Ames (Joe Sawyer), remembering how Tracy jinxed him back in WWII days, begs him not to re-enlist!

title: Five as Same
description: This is the story of five common girls and their five best friends who are living their individual lives, facing real and humane problems what girls face in Indian Society. They bravely face those problems and challenge the patriarchy in our society.

title: As It Happened
description: From newsprint to radio, from newsreels to television sets in our homes, the 24-hour cable news cycle, the digital information revolution... we find ourselves in a world where news is instantly available through a device in the palm of our hands. How we access news has rapidly and irrevocably evolved over the past century. We now consume news at a rate unprecedented at any time in history. And through all these changes, there has remained one constant: our fascination and hunger for information. "As It Happened" pulls back the curtain on some of the most shocking, notorious and captivating news stories of the past century. Stories that broke around the world, with new details unfolding day after day. Details consumed by an eager public, delivered through the collective experience of news media. From the media frenzy of the Lindbergh baby kidnapping or the televised capture and trial of OJ Simpson. We were on the ground in Iraq as we went to war, in the streets of Paris the night Princess Diana died, and in the Oval Office dissecting the Clinton/Lewinsky affair. These are the stories that started as global news and became media spectacles.

title: Reborn as a Cat
description: Ji Miaomiao, a young woman just starting her career, is betrayed by a friend and left with a mountain of debt. While fleeing from ruthless debt collectors, she accidentally falls from a building. On the brink of death, a mysterious figure transforms her into a cat.

title: Brothers at War
description: An intimate portrait of an American family during a turbulent time. Jake Rademacher sets out to understand the experience, sacrifice, and motivation of his two brothers serving in Iraq. The film follows Jake's exploits as he risks everything-including his life-to tell his brothers' story. Often humorous, but sometimes downright lethal, it is a remarkable journey where Jake embeds with four combat units in Iraq. Unprecedented access to US and Iraqi combat units take him behind the camouflage curtain with secret reconnaissance troops on the Syrian border, into sniper "hide sites" in the Sunni Triangle, through raging machine gun battles with the Iraqi Army. Ultimately, the film follows his brothers home where separations and life-threatening work ripple through their parents, siblings, wives, and children. It is a rare look at the bonds and service of our soldiers on the front lines and the profound effects their service has on the loved ones they leave behind.

title: La lumière au bout de la nuit
description: Amélie retrouve la vue après avoir été aveugle à cause d’un accident. À sa surprise, elle découvre que son mari a une liaison avec la bonne et qu’ils ont échangé son fils Noé contre leur propre enfant. Un complot affreux se cache derrière l’apparence d’une famille heureuse. Pour se venger, Amélie feint de rester aveugle. Elle reçoit le soutien de Jeanne, victime de violence domestique. Ces deux femmes s’entraident pour lutter contre leur destin.

title: Pardon Mon Affaire, Too!
description: Sequel to Pardon Mon Affaire. Four men continue to explore the fallout from their personal lives. This time they buy a house in the country, but struggle to escape their troubles.

title: Willy Wonka & the Chocolate Factory
description: A poor but hopeful boy seeks one of the five coveted golden tickets that will send him on a tour of Willy Wonka's mysterious chocolate factory.

title: To Be is Better Than Not to Be
Everything Will Be
description: As dawn breaks and most of the city still sleeps, the long-time merchants of Vancouver's Chinatown are hard at work. They haul out their produce stands and set up their makeshift vendor carts in preparation for what they hope will be a busy day. But, like many ethnic enclaves in urban centres across North America, their clientele is dwindling. This once vibrant and thriving neighbourhood is in flux as new condo developments and non-Chinese businesses move in and gradually overtake the declining hub of the Chinese community. Everything Will Be, from Sundance award-winning director Julia Kwan, captures this fascinating transformation through the intimate perspectives of the neighbourhood's residents, diverse merchants and new entrepreneurs, who offer their poignant reflections on change, memory and legacy. A public art installation erected on the roof of a local real estate mogul's contemporary art gallery - housed in one of the oldest buildings in Chinatown - illuminates in neon the words 'EVERYTHING IS GOING TO BE ALRIGHT.' Night and day, this sign looms over Chinatown. Everything is going to be alright. The big question is - for whom?

title: Quando a Lealdade Dele Chegou a Zero
description: Mia consegue ver uma pontuação de lealdade flutuando sobre cada cabeça. Seu amor de infância, Jack, manteve um cem perfeito por seis anos, até o ciúme se infiltrar e o número começar a cair. Quando ele se volta para a garota que chama de seu raio de sol, Mia não chora nem implora. Ela vai embora. Focando na própria corrida, ela se sente atraída pelo quieto Ethan, cujo cem nunca vacilou desde o dia em que o puxou para um grupo de educação física anos atrás. Jack afunda ao implorar, a segue de perto e usa artimanhas para reconquistá-la, mas Mia não corre mais atrás de promessas vazias. Ela escolheu aquele cujo número nunca caiu.

title: A White Man Walks Into A Barbershop
description: Filmmaker Kyle Schickner hits the road, crisscrossing America with the hope of examining racism's hold on our country, only to discover the grip racism has on him. Visiting barbershops, churches, and homes from Alabama to Minneapolis, from D.C to L.A, this honest, humorous, searing documentary pulls the veil away from white liberal ideology and the social warriors who use race and cancel culture as a weapon. See what happens when - A White Man Walks Into A Barbershop.

title: May Brent, Ralph at Michael! Miss Q&A candidates, WINNER sa kilig!
description:
Ngayong July 3 and every day, ang tawanan sa "It's Showtime ay free. Kasama ang mga kandidata ng Miss Q and A, ang good vibes ay times three!

Sina Agua ng Parañaque City, Raux Araneta ng Negros Occidental at Kyla ng Laguna, kanya-kanyang paandar sa pagpapakilala sa Madlang People. Pero ang pinakagusto nilang makilala, eh 'di ang mga crush nila! Parang Valentine's season sa buwan ng Hulyo, kilig ng ladies ay todo-todo dahil kina Michael Sager, Ralph de Leon, at Brent Manalo.

Pero hindi lang crush ang kayang nilang ipaglaban, dahil pati sa social issues ay hindi matitinag ang kanilang paninindigan. Syempre, namana nila ang tapang ni Vice Ganda, na hindi matatakot 'ipahiya' ang mga magnanakaw, lalo na 'yung mga sangkot sa flood control scam, kung sakaling makasabay niya ito sa daan. Pero kung guwardiyado ang magnanakaw, teka lang, ibang usapan na 'yan.

Mukhang na-inspire ang mga kandidata kina Michael, Ralph at Brent dahil sa unang round ay mabilis ang kanilang pagpindot at pagsagot. Sina Agua at Raux ang nanguna sa Tumpak Ganern at nag-face off sa Round 2 na Wit Lang.

Parehong magaling! Mga answers nila ay winning! Kaya naman 'it's a tie' ang resulta. Sa araw na 'to, mayroon tayong dalawang Miss Q&A Reyna TalakEra.

Sa pinakabagong inaabangan na 'teleserye' sa tanghalian, ang You Gotta Lyric portion ng Laro Laro Pick, pang-finale ang eksena nina Vice Ganda bilang MemeRimar at Vhong Navarro bilang Sergio.

From aktingan, back to hosting si Vice Ganda upang papiliin si Duday, ang lucky player from Mandaluyong, kung Pot o Li-Pot ba ang desisyon niya. Wala nang patumpik-tumpik pa, Li-Pot offer ay itinodo na! Kaya hindi na rin nagdalawang-isip si Duday, at tinanggap na ang Li-Pot.

Ngunit laking pagsisisi ni Duday dahil nang subukan ang POT question, tama sana ang sagot niya. Pero tulad ng ipinangako ni Vice Ganda, dinagdagan niya ng P5,000 ang papremyo ni Duday sa oras na makasagot ito nang tama.

title: Misis Jawo, nag-level up sa Miss Q and A RESBAKULAWAN
description:
Malamig at nakakakilig na boses ang ipinarinig ng 4PLAY, na binubuo nina Ian Manibale, Miah Tiangco, Eich Abando, at Mark Justo. Pati pagbati sa Madlang People ay may harmony!

Sa Miss Q and A Resbakulawan Day 3, hindi nagpatumpik-tumpik pa sina Misis Jawo, Raux Araneta, at Cyrich Abril Patalinhug Castillo sa unang round na Wit Lang, kung saan agad silang sumabak sa mga pageant questions.

Sina Misis Jawo at Cyrich ang pumasok sa next round, Beklamation, kung saan hinarap nila ang iisang tanong na, "Kung ang kaibigan mong may matagal ng utang sa'yo na hindi binayaran ay muling lumapit para mangutang dahil sa isang emergency, pauutangin mo ba?"

Si Misis Jawo ang kinoronahan sa Day 3 ng Miss Q and A Resbakulawan.

Sa buhay, don't be shy dahil when you ask, the universe listens at ang swerte sa'yo ibibigay. Mabenta ang good vibes sa Laro Laro Pick game arena. Mga sales men and ladies ang bumida!

Hindi lang players ang may magandang kuwento, dahil si Ryan Bang ay may good news din na dala. Ipinagmalaki ng oppa ang Permanent Residence (PR) niya sa Pinas! Kaya naman extra inspired si Ryan na sumabak sa Act-Song portion ng You Gotta Lyric round.

Maya-maya pa, si player Aik ang umabante sa jackpot round kung saan matapang iyang sinugalan ang P100, 000 POT question, tungkol sa kung anong species ng hayop ang na-rescue na si Sawaga-Dalwagan. Full of suspense ang anunsyo ni Vice Ganda kung tama ba ang sagot ni Aik na "Philippine Eagle." Hanggang sa in-announce na tama nga at maiuuwi nito ang papremyo!

title: Hosts Miss Q&A candidates nag reveal ng LOVE STATUS
description:
Anuman ang status ng 'yong puso, saktong-sakto ang happiness at good vibes na hatid ng "Showtime Online U" squad na nagse-celebrate ng 10th anniversary.

PaLOVEan sa rampahan at talakan sina Miss Q and A candidates Callout Everdean, Adam Lambert, at Cali Serion.

Feeling reyna agad si Callout dahil sa winner niyang love life. Ipinakilala ng kandidata ang kanyang American husband. Ibang mukha ng pag-ibig naman ang ipinakita ni Adam, na focused muna sa career dahil na-trauma sa past relationship. Si Cali naman na isang iskolar ng bayan, pag-ibig ng ina ang inaasam.

Dahil napag-uusapan na ang pag-ibig, naisip ni Vice na alamin ang love status ng "It's Showtime" hosts. Na-intriga ang Madlang People sa mga status nina Kim Chiu, Darren Espanto, at Jackie Gonzaga. Pero ang status na pinakatumagos sa puso ng hosts at Madlang People, 'yung sinabi ni Ryan Bang, "Nadurog parang paminta. Pero may bubuo. Sino kaya?"

Agad nakapasok ang University of the Philippines student na si Cali sa Wit Lang round, kung saan ibinuhos niya ang puso sa tanong na, "Ano ang gagawin mo kung sa sobrang bait mo handa ka nang kunin ni Lord?" In-enjoy naman ni Adam ang talak sa tanong na, "Ano ang nararamdaman ng valid ID na laging dalawa silang hinahanap?"

Dahil sumilip na ang Haring Araw, extra sunny at bubbly ang mood ng mga taga-Malinta, Valenzuela na sumalang sa Laro Laro Pick game arena.

Nakakuwentuhan ng hosts si Angel, isang masipag na nanay. Sa kanilang usapan, napa-isip si Vice Ganda sa pagkakaiba ng bawat henerasyon. Kaya nga ba minsan 'magulo' ang mundo dahil sa pagsasama-sama ng iba't ibang henerasyon?

Samantala, nakaka-Gen Z ang kilig na hatid nina Darren at Jackie sa isang eksena. Aba, si Darren, nagpapalambing na! Panindigan n'yo kilig namin!

Sumikat ang swerte kay JM matapos niyang malampasan ang lahat ng challenges. Umabot sa P30,000 ang Li-Pot offer at sinubukan pa ni Kim na kumbinsihin si JM na tanggapin ito. Pero hindi nagpatinag si JM at sinugalan ang POT question. Magtagumpay kaya si JM at maiuwi ang P300,000 POT money?

title: A Song of Loves: R. David Buzaglo
description: Rabbi David Buzaglo was the greatest Hebrew liturgical poet of the twentieth century. Born in Morocco in 1903, his literary output had a major impact on a community of hundreds of thousands of people. From his prolific period in the Diaspora to the years he spent in a ruptured Israel, Buzaglo's poetry initiated an abrupt shift in Sephardic liturgical writing, but it also served as a vital link between the modern era and a tradition that dates back to Spanish Jewry's Golden Age. But Buzaglo was more than just a great poet. The actions he took at seminal moments in history had a critical impact in shaping the identity of Maghreb Jews. This film is an intimate look at Buzaglo's life and career, from its roots in the rich tradition of Hebrew poetry in Morocco through the liturgical revolution in Israel.

title: Hovory s TGM
description: On 26 September 1928, Karel Capek and President T.G. Masaryk meet in the gardens of Topolcianky castle to decide about the fate of their joint literary work. Their fiction film dialogue is based on quotes from a future book and their mutual correspondence, considerably freeing the original format of literary conversation from binding conventions. Capek and Masaryk reproach and offend each other, but they also ask key personal questions and questions about the social functions of a writer and politician respectively. "It's a film about two extraordinary men; it's about the fact that emotions can be sometimes more powerful than ideas even in such exceptional people.

title: I Am Nasrine
description: When you change where you are do you change who you are? I Am Nasrine is an intimate journey of self-discovery and ultimately reveals the unfolding of a soul. Set in modern day Tehran, and the UK, the film follows the paths of Nasrine and Ali, sister and brother in a comfortable, middle class Iranian home. When Nasrine has a run-in with the police, the punishment is more than she bargained for. At her father's bidding, Nasrine and Ali set out for the UK, torn about leaving behind their home and all that they know, embarking on a reluctant exile. Still, for Nasrine, there is undeniable excitement about the prospect of starting a new life in the West, and an eagerness for its promise of new freedoms. Arriving in Britain, their fate and their future are far from certain. Nasrine is quick to settle into her new life, making friends, forming bonds, including Nichole from the gypsy/travelers community. All the while her brother Ali struggles with the realities of life in the UK and his awakening sexuality. Then comes 9/11. Their parents will be unable to join them in Britain, leaving them quite alone. Things spiral further out of control when an unimaginable tragedy occurs. Nasrine must discover an incredible courage within her to accept what fate has dealt her; discovering that the end of her journey is really just the beginning. Can hope, simple untainted hope, overcome the darkest of tragedies? I Am Nasrine explores these questions and more, and offers answers that are sure to surprise.

title: Linda, Be Good
description: Linda Prentiss joins a burlesque troupe to get information for a novel she is writing without her husband, Roger Prentiss, knowing about it. Not knowing who he is, she meets her husband's boss, Sam Thompson, while on a night-clubbing tour with the show's burlesque queen Margie LaVitte. Later, the boss takes a client and Roger to the burlesque show, and Roger is stunned to see his wife as one of the stars.

title: I'll Be There
description: Scarred from her father Poch (Gabby Concepcion) leaving 15 years ago, New York-based Maximina dela Cerna (KC Concepcion) meets him in the Philippines to claim her inheritance left by her mom to make her dreams in New York come true. But Poch, hoping to reconnect with his daughter, asks her to live with him in Sta. Elena for 30 days before giving her what she needs. Though unable to stand her father, Maxi is left with no choice but to agree. It is in Sta. Elena that Maxi meets Tommy (Jericho Rosales), a fun-loving single father who gives Maxi his frank but insightful opinions about her angst towards her father. Through this, Maxi learns to open herself to seeing Poch in a new light, allowing for them to close off their past wounds and start again. But as they slowly learn to become father and daughter again, will Maxi be able to give up her aspirations to live with her father? Will Poch be able to let go of the daughter he waited so long to be with? After leaving, and being left behind, does one ever stop knowing how to love?

title: My Little Baby
description: Jung Han, a top murder squad detective in the special investigation bureau of violent crimes becomes the sole guardian of his 6-month-old niece, Eun Ae when his sister and her husband pass away unexpectedly.

description: Julien Bernardini, a young French journalist, is planning to do an interview by now aged movie-star Ava Gardner, who lives secluded in her London mansion and who refuses any interview by phone. title: Salma w Sari
description: Salma and Sari is about two young Palestinians who find themselves in a situation they weren't ready for. The series is set in East Jerusalem, where life under Israeli occupation is stressful and pressure leads to aggression. Their friends and family make it difficult for them to make their own decisions and follow their dreams. Salma is only eighteen. She grew up without a father, and pressure on her mother to protect Salma from society grows. Salma has a passion for photography, and struggles to convince her mother to support her goals. She has to take matters into her own hands, to follow her dreams, whatever the cost. Sari didn't go to college and works at his family business. He's good at what he does, but that's not good enough for his family. As he reaches the age of twenty four, his family insists it's time to marry and start a family. Sari's friends have different plans for him. They are young, bored, and love cars. And you know what that means - trouble. This creative drama for social change is set in East Jerusalem and other areas in the West Bank.

Malungkot at heartbreaking man ang lyrics ng kanta niya, napa-happy naman tayo ni Maki dahil sa good vibes at energy niyang dala, lalo pa nang sumabak sa “Oooh Lala Baby” dance challenge kasama ang Baby Dolls. Super game si Maki sa paggiling, to the point na hinamon pa niya ang host na si Darren Espanto sa isang dance showdown na ikinaaliw naman ng lahat.

Hindi lang si Maki ang nakisaya sa Showtime fam, kundi pati na rin sina Sue Ramirez at Rico Blanco upang imbitahan ang lahat na panoorin at suportahan ang upcoming movie nila na “Project Baby.” Tila naman nawala nang sandali ang angas ng OPM rock icon dahil napasabak din sila ni Sue sa “Oooh Lala Baby” dance challenge.

Samantala, labindalawang groovy at energetic senior citizens mula Navotas City ang naglaro sa “Laro Laro Pick.” Nakipagkuwetuhan at nakipagkulitan ang hosts na sina Vice Ganda, Jhong Hilario, at Vhong Navarro kina Nanay Baby, Nanay Felly, at Tatay Elly na magiliw na nagbahagi ng kanilang buhay at bonding moments kasama ang kanilang mga mahal na anak at apo.

Dahil wala sa mga kalahok ang nakaabot sa jackpot round, kinailangan ni Vice na bumunot ng isang pangalan mula sa kanila na magkakaroon ng tsansang mag-uwi ng P150,000. Hindi man pinalad si Tatay Elly sa unang sabak niya, nabigyan naman siya ng ikalawang pagkakataon na magpatuloy sa laro dahil siya ang masuwerteng napili ni Vice.

Nahalina man siya noong una nina Ate Girl Jackie Gonzaga at Kim Chiu sa offer nilang P30,000, biglang nagbago ang isip ni Tatay Elly at nag-desisyong mag-POT matapos na sabihin ni Vice Ganda sa kanya na ang jackpot question ay may kinalaman sa eleksyon. Bilang proud botante ng Navotas City, tila nakaramdam siya ng confidence na masasagot niya ang katanungan.

Sa kasawiang-palad, hindi nasagot nang tama ni Tatay Elly ang katanungang, “Ano ang minimum na edad ng isang kandidato upang makatakbo bilang pangulo ng Pilipinas?” Gayunpaman, hindi naman hinayaan ni Vice na umuwi siyang P1,000 lang ang dala dahil nangako siyang bibigyan ito ng P10,000 bilang pantulong sa pambili niya ng maintenance medicines.

Para sa ikalawang araw ng national finals ng “Tawag ng Tanghalan” Year 10, sina Charlie Palalisan ng General Santos City, Arbasa Abdulkarim ng Tawi-Tawi, at Will de Sosa ng Carmona, Cavite ang naglaban-laban upang mapabilib ang mga huradong sina Sofronio Vasquez, Klarisse de Guzman, and Ogie Alcasid.

Unang sumalang sa tanghalan ang aspiring lawyer ay miyembro ng B’laan tribe na si Charlie, na pinamangha ang lahat sa makabagbag-damdamin niyang rendisyon ng “Tulog Na” ng Sugarfree. Sumunod na nagtanghal ang high school teacher at proud haligi ng tahanan na si Arbasa, na sinubukang kilitiin ang lahat sa version niya ng “Your Man” ni American artist Josh Turner. Panghuli ay si Will, na inentertain ang lahat sa kakaibang twist na nilapat niya sa “Mr. Suave” ng Parokya ni Edgar.

Sa huli, ang mga pambato ng Region 12 (SOCKSARGEN) na si Charlie at ng Region 4 (Calabarzon at Mimaropa) na si Will ang mga idineklarang pasok na sa grand finals, matapos na makakuha ng scores na 94.3% at 91.3%, respectively. Samantala, si Arbasa naman ay nakatanggap lamang ng 90.3%.

description: Depicts the story of a high-achieving, low-income student who takes the College Scholastic Ability Test (CSAT) for another person to avoid blackmail. To obtain the "score" that will determine their future, a survival CSAT war unfolds thrillingly with betrayals and tricks everywhere. It is expected to expose the dark side of entrance exams unflinchingly through the "unfair" children who search for the correct answer amid extreme dilemmas.

title: TAMED
description: Haunted by childhood trauma, Cheng Yu'an has shut himself off from the world. One rainy night, he takes in Lin Qi and they begin living together under a "master and pet" contract. But the gentle Lin Qi keeps breaking the rules, prompting Cheng Yu an to make exceptions, even going so far as to defy his family for him. As Lin Qi searches for the truth behind his father's death, Cheng Yu'an's buried secrets begin to surface. From offering him shelter to being unable to let him go, who will surrender his heart first in this game of taming? A cold-hearted lawyer and a gentle artist in a steamy romance. From pet to lover, who falls first?

title: Tales of Demons and Gods [English] S1-S9
description: In his past life, although too weak to protect his home when it counted, out of grave determination Nie Li became the strongest Demon Spiritist and stood at the pinnacle of the martial world. However, he lost his life during the battle with the Sage Emperor and six deity-ranked beasts. His soul was then brought back to when he was still 13 years old. Although he's the weakest in his class with the lowest talent, having only a red soul realm and a weak one at that, with the aid of the vast knowledge which he accumulated from his previous life, he decided to train faster than anyone could expect. He also decided to help those who died nobly in his previous life to train faster as well. He aims to protect the city from the coming future of being devastated by demon beasts and the previous fate of ending up destroyed. He aims to protect his lover, friends, family and fellow citizens who died in the beast assault or its aftermath. And he aims to destroy the so-called Sacred family who arrogantly abandoned their duty and betrayed the city in his past life.

title: The Magic Brush Millionaire: Drawing My Superstar Lover
description: Broke street artist Chris receives a magical brush that brings anything he paints to life. After creating a living portrait of Hollywood superstar Shirley, he uses his gift to rise from poverty, defeat a corrupt gallery owner and a controlling agent, and protect the real Shirley. As miracles blur the line between art and reality, Chris builds an artistic empire—and wins the heart of the woman who inspired it all.

title: Forever After, Never Again (DUBBED)
description: Neglected by her father and stepmother since childhood, Elara Rhode hires Ethan Walden as her personal bodyguard—only to fall in love with him and begin pursuing his affection. But Ethan remains distant. Unbeknownst to Elara, he is secretly the heir to the powerful Walden family—and harbors feelings for her stepsister instead. Devastated and furious, Elara impulsively marries Charlie Shaw, a man trapped in a vegetative state.

title: [Doublé] Il ne reste plus toi dans ma vie
description:
Sophie, véritable dirigeante du Groupe Célestia, avait renoncé à son rôle au sommet de l’entreprise afin de soutenir son mari Alex. Elle s’était volontairement retirée pour devenir femme au foyer, et avait consacré sept années entières à prendre soin de sa famille. Elle avait même veillé sur Alex lorsqu’il avait été gravement malade, l’ayant accompagné sans relâche jusqu’à sa guérison, en y mettant toute son énergie et toute sa tendresse.



Cependant, cet amour qu’elle avait donné sans compter s’était transformé en une trahison totale. Le jour même de la cérémonie des cent jours de leur fils Léo, Alex a ramené sa maîtresse Emma ainsi que son fils illégitime Félix. Sous la complaisance de ses parents, Alex a imposé à Sophie un choix injuste : soit accepter la cohabitation avec Emma et Félix et continuer à servir la famille Bernard, soit divorcer sans pouvoir emmener son enfant.

title: A Winter Sun Wakes the Wind in Spring Hills' Dream

title: You Are My Fateful Love
description: Ruan Yu quits her job at 28 to write full-time. When accused of plagiarism, she hires IP lawyer Xu Huaisong-her high school crush who inspired her novel's hero. As they work together, old feelings return and deepen through challenges.

title: My Stepbrother by Day, My Forbidden Lover by Night
description: On a first-class flight to her mother’s wedding, broke scholarship student Lily spends one reckless night with Ryder, an irresistible football star. By morning, she plans to forget him—until she arrives at her new home and discovers he is her future stepbrother. Lily vows to stay away to protect her mother’s hard-won happiness, but Ryder refuses to pretend they are family.

title: Royal Betrothal
description: In a crumbling dynasty plagued by corruption, a brilliant orphan becomes the first female scholar to pass the imperial exams. She joins forces with a masked emperor who moonlights as a vigilante to expose conspiracies.

title: The Hidden God-Tier Dragon Knight

title: Laawaris Shehzada
description: Humiliated by love… what happens when his ultra-rich parents return after 20 years? 💥👑

title: Bring it on, My Mafia Life
description: Sold for five million, Rhea was traded by her parents to the mafia Lukas. While Lukas was supposed to treat her as a mere plaything, he unexpectedly went to great lengths to protect her in the perilous world of the mafia. Does he genuinely love her, or is he merely considering her as part of a dangerous yet thrilling game?

title: Oops, I’m the Billionaire You Dumped
description: Before leaving for Africa, Kang Do-hyun proposed to Kim Ji-min. Five years later he returns; Ji-min, now a Harvard PhD, dumps him for a chaebol heir—never asking who he really is: the chairman of Titan Group. Flying home, heiress of Summit Group, Lee Chae-won, begs him for a one-year contract marriage. He refuses, but secretly rewrites her 100-billion proposal into 1,000 trillion. Mocked as a fraud, he hides his name—until the truth breaks, and everyone who mocked him kneels.

title: The Magicless Boy Is the First Mage
description: The Magicless Boy Is the First Mage

title: Roses for My Little Moon
description: At 15, Evan Jose met the love of his life. Having been diagnosed with a rare illness since childhood and given no more than 30 years to live, Evan tasted a candy from Tina Skyler, and that very candy drove away his misery. Over the years, Evan kept supporting Tina, watching his little moon grow into an exceptional dancer. When he had only 7 months left to live, he made a selfish decision. He married her, aiming to love her silently, as he had done for the past 14 years. But he forgot that the look of love can't be hidden. His feelings grew stronger. He reveled in her cute yet awkward attempts to please him, was captivated by her unintentional touches, and couldn't bear the thought of any other man near Tina. With his life slipping away and his love impossible to let go, a countdown of love began.

title: Trembling Before G-d
description: A cinematic portrait of various gay Orthodox Jews who struggle to reconcile their faith and their sexual orientation.

title: E the King
description: An out of work Elvis impersonator heads to Hollywood looking for work or is he running from his past?

title: Bianco e nero
description: An italian engineer and a beautiful black woman both married had an affair turning his life's into a hard forbidden romance.

title: Lui e lei
description: Roma. Lui, Claudio Romano, è un promettente avvocato di buona famiglia, che lavora in uno degli studi più affermati della città, e sembra destinato a una brillante carriera e a sposare la figlia del titolare. La sua vita comincia a cambiare il giorno in cui si imbatte in un caso completamente estraneo al suo mondo professionale: la difesa d'ufficio di un adolescente "difficile". Ciro, accusato di omicidio. E' la riscoperta di un mondo che aveva più o meno consciamente messo da parte per coltivare l'affermazione professionale e l'ascesa sociale, ma che risponde ai suoi veri ideali di legge e di giustizia. Lei, Giulia Pisano, è un commissario di polizia, dal passato difficile di ragazza senza famiglia, cresciuta in istituto e salvata appena in tempo da un poliziotto ora capo della Squadra Mobile, il vicequestore Aldo Ricci, che ora è anche il suo uomo. Istintiva, avversa ai compromessi, determinata, talora anche scontrosa, Giulia si butta a capofitto nei casi di cui si occupa. Assegnata contro la sua volontà a casi in cui sono coinvolti dei minori, la giovane commissaria scoprirà, grazie anche all'intesa - professionale, umana e affettiva - con l'avvocato Romano, che quella è la sua vera strada. Diversi per estrazione sociale, carattere, passato, Giulia e Claudio si trovano a lavorare fianco a fianco dapprima scontrandosi, poi a poco a poco scoprendosi complementari. Il loro è un sentimento che cresce nel tempo e si approfondisce anche in seguito alla morte di Aldo Ricci, ucciso da una banda. E poi Ciro. Quattordici anni, una vita di espedienti. L'incontro con Claudio, è folgorante. Si aggrappa a lui e non lo molla più. Claudio, che con i bambini ci sa fare, ne chiederà l'affidamento temporaneo, quando la madre di Ciro sarà condannata per spaccio di droga.

title: Janjal-e bozorg
description: An old man has two problems. The first is to convince his prospective son-in-law to make a home for himself as soon as possible and remove the bride-to-be from his house, lest he banned from the old man's home. The second is the preservation of his savings, which he keeps as cash in the lining of his coat instead of in a bank. One day a thief [Akbar Abdi] comes into their apartment complex to take advantage of the old man's lack of awareness to give the slip to agents who are pursuing him. The thief grabs the coat and flees. From then on the old man, the son-in-law, the girl, the agents and the thief are all trying to get their hands on this valuable coat.

title: Snake Eyes
description: Snake Eyes, a tenacious loner, is welcomed into an ancient Japanese clan called the Arashikage, who teach him the ways of the ninja and provide him home. But when secrets from his past are revealed, his honor and allegiance will be tested.

title: Yet Another Story
description: Two lovers from differing cultural backgrounds are separated by their parents for one year in order to prove if their love is true.

title: O Jackie
description: A tale of love, power, infidelity and tragedy, O Jackie recounts a pivotal moment in the lives of three icons of the 20th Century, Jacqueline Kennedy, Aristotle Onassis and Maria Callas. Set in 1968 on the small Greek Island of Skorpios, the 'wedding of the century' is about to take place between the former First Lady and the hugely wealthy shipping tycoon. What starts off as a pleasant and civilised celebration soon descends to something more chaotic where passions bubble to the surface, secrets are revealed and the true nature of this iconic marriage becomes apparent.

title: O Sobrado
description: The siege of the residence of a political leader in the late 19th century, including conflicts between besieged occupants.

title: O methystakas
description: A poor cobbler has become a drunkard and the laughing stock of the whole neighborhood, besetting his daughter. When she falls in love with a rich young man, her father tries in vain to hide his passion from his family.

title: O Desejo
description: Widowed one year ago, Eleonora, a 33-year-old woman from Sao Paulo's upper bourgeoisie, lives alone, unsuited to her husband's absence, an intellectual frustrated and torn between the need for transcendence and a strong sexual compulsion. The life of the couple, although not happy, was intense. However, the presence of her a long-time friend Ana Maria, just arrived from Paris, a middle-class university student, is staying at his house. The two go to the site of Eleonora and she remembers her life with Marcelo and his death by drowning.

title: O Manolios xanahtypa
description: Secretly in love with his boss' daughter, a clerk with a lovely singing voice turns his luck around when he catches the eye of the famous singer, Giorgos Zambetas. Now, he must make a life decision: which is more important, love or fame?

title: Kafû o machiwabite
description: One day Akio receives a strange letter from a woman named Sachi. It turns out that the letter was a response to a joke wish he hung up at a Shinto shrine months earlier. Then one day, Sachi shows up and the two begin a relationship.

title: Steve-O: Gnarly
description: After a long trip duct taped on the side of a truck from Vegas to Colorado, Steve-O and friends go over his epic life, and the gnarly stunts he has done to get there. Stunts are over the top shock-value but its Steve-O what do you expect?

title: Balada o pilotovi
description: Emil Malik, a former RAF captain returns home to his family in 1945 hoping for a happy life after surviving the horrors of war piloting combat aircrafts. He will clash against the reality of those he left behind under the overseeing eye of communism within the Iron Curtain.

title: Bachna O Haseeno
description: 💖 Betrayed in love, chosen by destiny - can he handle his billionaire life? 🔥 Fr

title: O quê! Meu husky é o rei lobo!?
description: Shellie, uma caçadora de coelhos pobre e alegre, caça na propriedade todos os dias para pagar os remédios da avó. Um dia, ela resgata um lobo ferido e, achando ser um husky de raça duvidosa, o batiza de Jet. Com um simples carinho na cabeça, ela o doma e o transforma em seu cão de caça. A verdadeira identidade de Jet é Hoyer, o último rei lobo, cujo nome aterroriza a todos. Gravemente ferido, ele planejava devorar essa garota imprudente de uma vez, mas descobre que ficar ao lado de Shellie restaura sua magia. Para sobreviver, o orgulhoso rei lobo engole o orgulho e se finge de cachorro, às vezes assumindo a forma de um homem incrivelmente atraente de abdômen trincado. Aonde quer que Shellie vá, seja para a escola ou para o trabalho, ela o leva junto. Garotas manipuladoras e veteranos ricos tentando conquistá-la são sumariamente barrados pela atitude dominadora de Hoyer. Aos poucos, ele perde a vontade de ir embora. Sua mente se enche de pensamentos como: Por que ela não coçou minha barriga hoje? e Será que o cara que mandou a carta de amor para ela quer morrer? Até que uma misteriosa organização de caçadores lança um ataque surpresa em massa. Para proteger Shellie, Hoyer assume sua forma humana, revelando completamente o disfarce. Chocada, mas firme, o forte instinto protetor de Shellie vem à tona, despertando uma antiga linhagem de caçadora. Ela joga o arquivilão no chão e o enche de pancada. Com a crise resolvida, o rei lobo, que deveria estar reconstruindo seu clã, não dá a mínima para os problemas do mundo, preferindo seguir Shellie o dia todo implorando por abraços.

title: Xuxa, O Documentário
description: The life and times of Xuxa, the Brazilian TV personality who rose to international fame in the 1990s.

title: Giannis Kastritsis: O anthropos kai o iskios tou
O zivej vode
description: Adaptation of the fairy-tale by the Grimm Brothers. The three sons of a king set out on a quest to find the magical "Water of Life" to save their father.

title: O Marido Desesperado
description: Li Wei foi um empresário bem-sucedido, mas após ir à falência, ele se tornou um limpador de janelas. Um dia, enquanto trabalhava, ele acidentalmente testemunhou um homem e uma mulher tendo um caso. A faixa de cabelo com orelhas de coelho da mulher e a pequena marca de flor vermelha fizeram-no suspeitar de infidelidade por parte de sua esposa. Quando voltou para casa, descobriu a mesma marca em sua esposa, Lin Xiaoya, o que aprofundou suas dúvidas. A partir daí, Li Wei plantou a semente da desconfiança em seu coração e começou a investigar sua esposa. Através de uma série de eventos, Li Wei finalmente descobriu a verdade...

title: Priya O Priya
description: Two rich brothers have a crush on their driver's daughter. Who will end up winning the girl's heart?

title: Laj o lajbazi
description: Pooneh, played by Sara Khoeiniha, and Farhad, played by Amir Jafari, have been separated for about three years after 15 years of living together. Pooneh's acquaintance with a young man becomes an incentive for Farhad to oust his love rival.

title: Tú o nadie
description: A young woman gets involved in a feud between two brothers.

title: O xypolytos pringips
description: Run out of options and in desperate need of cash, a down-and-out young man accepts his rich hotelier friend's preposterous proposal to impersonate an exotic Arab Prince. But what does the bride-to-be has to say about this scandalous farce?

title: O Marido Disfarçado
description: Su Nuanyan, CEO do Grupo Su, é abandonada por seu noivo após ser traída. Em um momento de fúria, ela se casa com Qi Sili. No entanto, devido ao seu destino, Qi Sili precisa fingir ser um tolo por nove anos. Depois de se tornar marido de Su Nuanyan, ele a apoia silenciosamente nos bastidores, ajudando-a a evitar ser alvo de humilhações, enquanto sua verdadeira identidade quase é descoberta por Su Nuanyan várias vezes.

title: O Filho Perdido de Zeus: O Retorno Triunfal
description: Hércules, filho de Zeus e Hera, desaparece ainda criança, e um seguidor invejoso o troca por Ícaro, um mortal. Dezoito anos depois, ele vai ao Olimpo para entrar para os Guardiões do Olimpo e salvar sua amada, superando Ícaro de longe. Sem saber quem ele realmente é, a família de Zeus, manipulada por Ícaro, o humilha e o exila. Quando a verdade é revelada, a família de Zeus implora desesperadamente por seu perdão, enquanto Ícaro trama vingança ao lado de Hades.

title: Lakis o glykoulis
description: Lakis is a hard-working and innocent married man, who hasn't finished high-school because he became a father at a very young age. His father dies and his will determines that, if Lakis is able to finish high school and get into a university, half of his fortune will belong to Lakis and the other half to his already rich brother.

title: O Garoto que o Quarterback Usou na Cama
description: Artur Mendes namorou escondido com o Quarterback Caio Rocha por seis meses. Caio nunca assumiu, preferindo fingir ser o casal perfeito com Daniela Mendes, irmã de Artur. Uma foto íntima de Artur vazou pelo campus após Daniela roubá-la do celular de Caio, que mandou Artur ficar quieto e continuou a usá-lo. O capitão do hóquei, Felipe Nogueira, abriu o Instagram na frente de todos: Quer sair comigo? Me segue primeiro. No dia seguinte, ele andou de mãos dadas com Artur no corredor, com os dedos entrelaçados para todo mundo ver. Daniela fingiu uma alergia a nozes para incriminar Artur, e ele enfiou a cabeça dela em uma fonte. Caio perdeu o jogo e gritou com Daniela na lateral do campo, destruindo sua imagem de garoto de ouro. Felipe venceu, olhou para a câmera e disse: Nosso goleiro segurou dois períodos sozinho. Não queria mais que ele carregasse isso sozinho. Todos entenderam.

title: O Grande Xerife
description: Inácio Pororoca is responsible for the local mail in an old west town. One day there comes bandit João Bigode, who kills the sheriff and puts Inácio on his place, just for fun. But Inácio takes his post seriously, and soon the bandits realize they've made a mistake.

title: Zulm-O-Sitam
description: Superintendent of Police Arun is a hardworking, honest and diligent police officer in Bombay. He has been assigned to lead the detail in charge of the state's Chief Minister's protection. Things do not go as planned, and the Chief Minister is killed. The police find evidence linking Arun with this killing, and have him arrested and imprisoned. Arun loudly claims he in innocent, but if he is innocent, who actually was involved in this killing?

title: Komediya o Lisistrate
description: Lysistrata led the women of ancient Greece in forcing men to stop the war, that was devastating the land. Lysistrata declared to women: "We must refrain from male altogether - till the men come to terms of peace".

title: O Bem-Amado
description: Sucupira's mayor, a corrupt politician full of tricks, has the inauguration of the local cemetery as his administration's priority, but is met with opposition led by the police chief and a newspaper journalist, in a deathless city.

title: Capo o héroe
description: Javier renace en familia rica, pero un sistema lo obliga a estudiar. Gana en matemáticas, salva vidas y crea el reactor Ark. Entre luchas de poder y matrimonios forzados, ayuda a otros y lleva a Gran Aurora a ser la primera potencia mundial.

title: O Caçador Supremo
description: Ele salvou o império. Depois, desapareceu. Por oito anos, Rael Montenegro viveu como andarilho, escondendo o nome que o mundo reverenciava — para proteger a família do mestre que morreu por ele. Mas a pobreza aperta, os inimigos cercam, e o Dragão Abissal volta. Na Seleção dos Caçadores Reais, Rael entra na arena como ninguém — e sai como uma lenda. Só que quanto mais ele tenta se esconder, mais a verdade vem à tona. E quando vier, vai custar tudo que ama.

title: Aranyak O Mudrarahasya
description: Aranyak a young detective comes to Kolkata with his assistant Shaumya to solve the mystery of a stolen numismatic coin after the murder of its owner Mr. Debayan. He adopts unique methods and style to solve the mystery.

title: O Sobrinho Dele é o Meu Pecado
description: Melanie Thorne é advogada de sucesso, divide escritório com o marido há dez anos e venceu o centésimo caso. George Dearborn volta do exterior para ser nomeado herdeiro da Dearborn Pharmaceuticals; é sobrinho do marido de Melanie. Quando se conhecem, a faísca é imediata e surge um amor intenso. Mas o universo, as famílias e a sociedade se voltam contra eles. Cederão às pressões ou ousarão acreditar que o mundo pertence a eles?

title: O Pai do Meu Filho É o Arquimago
description: Cinco anos depois de uma noite que mudou seu destino, a Rainha dos Lobos está prestes a perder a alcateia. Sua única esperança é encontrar o pai de seu filho. Quando finalmente consegue encontrá-lo, ela descobre que o homem é, na verdade, o poderoso Arquimago, justamente quem pode salvar ela e toda a alcateia.

title: O Segredo do Meu Marido: O Protetor
description: Um lendário comandante de guerra, vivendo disfarçado como mecânico, é forçado a voltar ao mundo do poder quando conhece uma CEO cujo império está desmoronando devido a uma armação cuidadosamente planejada. Juntos, eles iniciam uma retomada de alto risco, movida por amor, vingança e identidades secretas.

title: O Alfa Predestinado
description: Aos sete anos, Luan Moura desaparece para salvar a mãe lobisomem ferida, Helena Moura, após um acordo com o avô, Antônio Moura. Vinte anos depois, trabalhando como faxineiro e com amnésia, sua namorada Mariana Costa rouba sua pesquisa e o humilha com o herdeiro de sangue puro Júlio Ferraz. Helena, agora Alfa Suprema, chega para destruí-los, mas Antônio impede o reencontro. Sequestrado pelo renegado Mauro Viana, Luan vê Helena quase morrer por ele. Sua dor desperta o poder de nível Progenitor; ele mata Mauro, reencontra a mãe e ascende como Alfa Supremo.

title: O Piloto Fantasma
description: Após salvar em segredo uma base da Marinha, Matheus Carvalho, faxineiro e filho de um piloto desonrado, entra para a Forja Celeste, a elite da aviação militar. Enquanto enfrenta rivais e prova ser um piloto excepcional, Matheus descobre uma conspiração sobre a morte do pai e um poderoso senador disposto a esconder a verdade.

title: WITTY! Vhong at Jhong, sinubukan ang mga tanong sa Miss Q&A
description:
Weekend na, mga accla, kaya come out na sa lungga. Huwag puro "seen" sa GC kapag may nag-invite sa party-party lalo na't Pride Month celebration today. Join sa occasion ang "It's Showtime" family at ang mga weekly finalists ng "Miss Q and A."

From their daily round panalo, nagharap-harap sa panibagong talakan ang limang kandidata this Sabado—Shanaya De Guzman, Lixa Labbuanan, Lucky Robles Collins, Mama Mama, at Andrea Lim.

Na-challenge ang brain cells ng mga 'accla' sa Tumpak Ganern round, partikular na sa tanong tungkol sa pangalan ng isang senador. Pagkatapos ng Round 1, naligwak si Lixa, at ang apat naman ay umabante sa Wit Lang kung saan bumawi sila at pinalakpakan.

Nagtuloy-tuloy ang 'chukchakan' sa final round kung saan sina Mama Mama at Andrea ang naglaban. Iisang tanong lang ang ibinato sa kanila: "Anong materyal na bagay ang ireregalo mo sa nanay mong pagod?" "Ointment" ang sagot ni Mama Mama, at "bulaklak" naman para kay Andrea.

Nakisaya sa 'Laro Laro Pick' game arena ang mga residente ng Caloocan para subukan ang kanilang kapalaran! 'Napuruhan' si Teddy Corpuz sa aktingan. Paano ba naman, ang mga punchline, parang personalan. Kinarir naman ni Ogie Alcasid ang eksena bilang 'witch' na inakit si Brent Manalo. Kung may Best Actor sa araw na 'to, si Chief of OPM na 'yun, panigurado!

Dahil walang naka-survive sa lahat ng games, bumunot ng isang maswerteng eliminated player. At 'yun ay si Jomar! Para sa pamilya, si Jomar, hindi na sumugal pa at tinanggap na ang P25,000 offer sa Li-Pot.

title: Daddy U Misspelled Father
description: Trey can't fathom the importance of fatherhood, at least not until he's faced with an imminent eleven-year prison sentence. Jameelah, the mother of their three-year-old son, must suddenly deal with the immense struggles of being a single parent now that Trey is locked up. And at the same time, their young boy, Kiddo, is forced to deal with the emotional baggage that comes with his father's prolonged absence. Over time, Kiddo matures. He learns to see the world in his own light, and he ultimately decides he doesn't want anything to do with his incarcerated father. But upon his release from prison, Trey is a new man. He is brutally determined to prove his worth to his son. Unfortunately, gaining Kiddo's trust back will be one of the hardest things Trey has ever done.

title: Dai Sentai Goggle-V
description: The Dark Science Empire Desdark launches its scheme for world conquest from their Destopia Castle in Germany. Dr. Hideki Hongo, founder of the Future Science Laboratory, is saved from one of their attacks by world class explorer Kenichi Akama. Using his Computer Boys and Girls, Hongo recruits five people, including Kenichi, to form the Dai Sentai Goggle-V (Goggle 5), the only force capable of stopping Desdark.

title: Juan y Vanesa
description: When Juan, a 35-year-old truck driver learns he has a daughter, he decides to become responsible. He quits alcohol and takes one last chance at his job, to deliver various goods to Mexico City. At a gas station, Vanesa, a Mexican Lolita with pink-dyed hair convinces Juan to let her go with him. A rebellious teenager and a broken man start a journey where they confront each other and their own demons only to realize that this strange encounter can awake something unexpected and beautiful in them.

title: Tú, yo y mi avatar
description: A man or woman dates three avatars acting in behalf of his or her suitors before meeting them in person and deciding who he or she would date.

title: Las viciosas y la menor
description: A young woman, in love with a peasant, tries her fortune as a model in the capital, where she is seduced by lesbians.

title: Celedonio y yo somos así
description: Celedonio y yo somos así

title: La CEO y el Repartidor
description: Arturo Iglesias, un simple repartidor, jamás creyó que acabaría casado con una hermosa CEO. ¡Y encima, ella se lo pidió! Tras su último pedido, solo podía pensar: "¡Por fin, este holgazán cambió su suerte!"

title: El alazán y el rosillo
description: Rosendo vuelve a su pueblo natal, San Fernando, pero un antiguo amigo suyo ha estafado por toda la región. El decide frenar ese pillaje y se propone con Rosillo, un pura sangre, ganar varias carreras para devolver a los campesinos sus propiedades.

title: [Doblado]Entre Rayos y Traiciones
description: Mas entre antigas maldições e segredos dos deuses, será que ela conseguirá mudar o destino - ou acabará presa no mesmo jogo de amor e vingança?,Traición y poder en el Olimpo. Selene elige a Alejandro, desatando la furia de Escirón y las mentiras de Dafne. Entre maldiciones de Cerbero y sed de venganza, los dioses luchan por el trono y el verdadero amor.

title: [doblado]Entre amigos y amores
description: Durante siete años, Summer y Shawn compartieron un amor silencioso. Tras un beso impulsivo, él la rechazó por miedo al compromiso. Desilusionada, Summer acepta el cortejo de Julian, otro amigo de la infancia, pese a los celos de Shawn. Pero justo cuando su relación se afianza, Julian desaparece misteriosamente...

title: Su Humilde y Dura Esposa
description: Todos en la ciudad le temían, pero se casó con una mujer del campo que resultó saber de medicina, lucha, e incluso era dueña de parte de una gran empresa. El CEO le teme a su esposa, "¡Lo siento, no volveré a husmear en tus identidades secretas otra vez!"

title: Miles and Lies
description: It tells the story of Lu who loves to pretend that she has a perfect life but the reality is that she can't even pay her share of the bar that she opened with her two best friends so she works there as a bartender.

title: Papá mafioso y despiadado
description: El día que Ellie logra un embarazo mediante FIV, descubre que su prometido y su mejor amiga están teniendo una aventura. Devastada, decide criar a su hijo sola. Su doctora revela que hubo un error en el banco de esperma: lleva en su vientre al hijo del jefe de la mafia. Ellie se ve arrastrada involuntariamente a una guerra de sucesión dentro de la mafia. Para proteger a su bebé nonato, acepta un matrimonio por contrato con el jefe de la mafia. Ni ella ni él imaginaron que esto los llevaría al verdadero amor.

title: [Doblado]Tócala y arde
description: El día de mi compromiso, mi madre y yo estábamos en el carro esperando al chofer cuando la secretaria de mi prometido me mandó de pronto un video. En él, tenía a una loba de mediana edad tomada del cabello y le daba bofetada tras bofetada. "¡Selena, maldita interesada! ¿De verdad creíste que fingir ser una socialité y comprometerte con el Alfa Damián permitiría que tu madre se metiera a robar en su casa?" Otra bofetada cayó. El rostro de la mujer ya estaba horriblemente hinchado. "Típico de gente corriente. Siempre tomando lo ajeno. Como secretaria de Damián, me encargo de esta ladrona inmunda por él". Bajé lentamente el celular. A mi lado, mi madre se acomodaba el collar frente a su espejo compacto. Al notar que la miraba, sonrió y me acarició la mano. "La Manada Corona de Espinas puede ser un desastre en los negocios, cariño, pero Damián es guapísimo. Cuando la alianza sea oficial, tu padre y yo podremos arreglarlo todo". Frunciendo el ceño, reproduje el video otra vez. Los pómulos finos. El peinado impecable. Y el lunar en la oreja. Dios mío. ¡Era mi futura suegra, la señora Beltrán! Llamé de inmediato. "Vanessa, ¿tienes idea de lo idiota que eres? ¡Esa es la madre de Damián!" Ella soltó una risa cruel. "Ay, por favor. Damián ya me contó todo sobre ti. Una don nadie con la que su padre lo obligó a casarse. Ni siquiera le importas, así que ¿por qué le importaría tu familia?"

title: El cura y el veneno
description:
SINOPSIS El Cura y el Veneno

Una fiesta lujosa en la Embajada Francesa de Madrid se convierte en el escenario de un crimen mortal. Las circunstancias misteriosas que rodean la muerte de un hombre influyente acaban convirtiendo a algunos de los propios invitados en sospechosos de asesinato. El crimen que, a primera vista, parece ser resuelto, empieza a tomar un movimiento serpentino que, poco a poco, ira destapando secretos guardados y deseos ocultos, poniendo de relieve las manifestaciones del veneno interior que todos llevamos dentro.

Felipe, un modesto cura y profesor de un colegio religioso, se ve implicado de forma inesperada en tales acontecimientos en los que el poder manda y el engaño impregna lo cotidiano.

Forzado a iniciar una investigación al margen de la ley, Felipe se hunde en un mundo oscuro donde se topara, cara a cara, con sus propios demonios que han regresado de un turbio pasado.

Este largometraje actual, con reminiscencias propias del clasico cine negro, posee una estética fuertemente expresiva y una estilización visual impactante que crean una atmósfera difusa, oscura, donde las apariencias engañan y la desconfianza reina.

Los espectadores se veran sumergidos en un mundo de misterio y una maraña de intriga y conflicto hasta llegar a la resolucion menos esperada.



 SYNOPSIS The Priest and the Poison

A glamorous reception at the French Embassy in Madrid becomes the scene of a deadly crime. The mysterious circumstances surrounding the death of an influential man of the French elite transform some of the guests into murder suspects. The crime, which at first glance seems so easily solved, takes on a serpentine movement that, little by little, uncovers well-kept secrets and hidden desires, the manifestations of a personal poison that we all carry within.

Felipe, an unassuming priest and teacher at a religious school for boys, finds himself caught up in a series of murders of political intrigue. Forced to begin an independent investigation outside the law, Felipe finds himself so immersed in this world of death and mistrust, that he is thrown face to face with his own dark past, from which he had tried so hard to escape.

description: Tangled 8 is eight adaptations of the same script. The film explores the ways in which people of diverse social backgrounds, races and age manage grief through its different phases. Originally conceived as a single short film, director John E. Seymore re-imagined the piece as an anthology feature, based partly on the musical concept of variations on a theme. The script remains largely the same, but the action, visualization, situation and sound vary greatly with each new vignette. Finally, Tangled 8 is a film about film. It pays homage to John Ford, Woody Allen, Peter Greenaway and other filmmakers who have created the visual and thematic language of modern cinema.

title: Nowhere to Run
description: The world is breaking down after a meteor shower which has impacted a large portion of the Western Hemisphere. Devastation is brought to civilization as the meteorites rain down, but before they can repair the damages, a deeper threat emerges. In the Pacific Northwest, eight-year-old Erica's life is uprooted when she returns home from school to find herself running to stay alive. Erica has to run, gain new skills, and cooperate with those who are still among the living. She has no choice but to interact with a wide variety of characters from every walk of life and background. She has to determine to what extent to trust others, if any at all. The 'Nowhere to Run' series is a survival horror which includes suspenseful, thrilling, and dramatic elements. If you ever wondered what you'd do in a zombie apocalypse, picture yourself as eight years old and wonder again. Would you make it?

title: Adventures of an Earthling
description: Documentary filmmaker Mishara Canino-Hussung follows her husband as he investigates an old family story about the role his mother played in a series of mysterious sightings in upstate New York in the early 1990s. Her husband, fellow filmmaker Bill Hussung, is skeptical of the stories, but hopes to please his mother as she battles cancer in New York City. What follows is a quirky and contemporary look at the power of mythology, with two surprise endings that are sure to leave audiences wondering about the true nature of the mysterious lights in the night sky just north of New York City.

description: Louise is living in Montreal, unemployed. Her sister Paulette often gives her a hard time. She only gets to see her poetry-quoting married boyfriend Julien once a week. title: Au bon beurre
description: Léon Lécuyer, an idealistic history student, manages to escape from the camp where he was imprisoned and comes back to Paris. He hides in his mother's apartment when the Germans, informed by an anonymous letter, storm their block. He runs away once more and leaves for Lyon. Wishing to serve his country, Léon decides to kill Pierre Laval. But he does so badly that he is arrested and condemned to ten years in prison. Meanwhile in Paris, Charles-Hubert and Julie Poissonnard, the owners of the dairy shop "Au Bon Beurre", where Léon's mother shops, thrive by speculating on people's misery, by getting supplies on the black market, by selling goods ten times what they are worth, while blatantly supporting the policies of Maréchal Pétain. But when Charles-Hubert senses the wind turning, he changes attitudes. He saves a Jew and even "organizes" the Resistance in his neighborhood. After the war, the Poissonards, richer than ever, have gained a new respectability. As for Léon, now a history teacher at Lycée Jean-Baptiste Say, he is transferred against his will for ... giving bad grades to Henri, Poissonard's son.

title: The Detective Is Already Dead [Hindi]
description: Kimizuka Kimihiko is a crisis-magnet. From getting caught up in a crime scene to accidentally witnessing a drug deal, trouble seems to find him around every corner. So it is no surprise when his rather mundane flight suddenly enters a state of emergency with a dire need of a detective onboard. Unfortunately, his attempt at avoiding trouble is foiled by a beautiful girl with silver hair who goes by the codename Siesta. Declaring herself a detective, she unceremoniously drags Kimizuka into the case as her assistant. That incident spelled the beginning of an adventure around the globe that went beyond his wildest imagination. Putting their lives on the line, the two took down criminal organizations, prevented disasters, and saved thousands. But the curtain closed to their epic journey with Siesta's untimely death three years later. Resolving to live an ordinary high school life this time, Kimizuka spends a year maintaining a low profile. However, as fate would have it, a girl with an uncanny resemblance to Siesta comes crashing into his life, threatening to throw his peaceful days into disarray.

title: Scientific Thinking
description:
In 7 episodes, Crash Course Scientific Thinking will teach learners the foundational principles underlying scientific thought, pulling back the curtain on processes like peer review, interrogating what makes sources reliable (or not), unpacking how consensus is reached, and revealing how scientific understanding changes over time. Ultimately, learners will gain the ability to think more critically about the scientific information they encounter in their everyday lives. 

Series Objectives
- Describe the dynamic, communal nature of science, articulating the roles of uncertainty and consensus.
- Explain the role of peer review and replication in science.
- Unpack the potential for bias and error in science and understand its self-correction mechanisms.
- Understand the role of specialization in scientific expertise.
- Interpret primary, secondary, and tertiary sources, and use lateral reading to verify claims.
- Understand basic statistical language used to describe scientific findings.

title: English for Career Development
description:
Welcome to English for Career Development, a course created by the University of Pennsylvania, and funded by the U.S. Department of State Bureau of Educational and Cultural Affairs, Office of English Language Programs. 
To enroll in this course for free, click on “Enroll now” and then select "Full Course. No certificate."
This course is designed for non-native English speakers who are interested in advancing their careers in the global marketplace. In this course, you will learn about the job search, application, and interview process in the United States, while comparing and contrasting the same process in your home country. This course will also give you the opportunity to explore your global career path, while building your vocabulary and improving your language skills to achieve your professional goals. The first unit in this course will introduce the U.S. job application process and provide strategies for identifying the jobs that match your interests and skills. Unit 2 will take you through the steps necessary to produce a professional-looking resume. In unit 3, you will work to develop a clear and concise cover letter. The final unit of the course focuses on networking and interview skills.
Anyone may take this course for free. If you want to get a Coursera Verified Certificate for free, please fill out the Financial Aid form.
 Unless otherwise noted, all course materials are available for re-use, repurposing and free distribution under a Creative Commons 4.0 Attribution license.
Supplemental reading materials were provided by Newsela, which publishes daily news articles at a level that's just right for each English language learner.

title: Programming with JavaScript
description: JavaScript is the programming language that powers the modern web. In this course, you will learn the basic concepts of web development with JavaScript. You will work with functions, objects, arrays, variables, data types, the HTML DOM, and much more. You will learn how to use JavaScript and discover interactive possibilities with modern JavaScript technologies. Finally, you will learn about the practice of testing code and how to write a unit test using Jest.

title: Business English: Capstone Project
description:
The capstone project will give you opportunities to demonstrate your competence in the learning objectives for this Specialization. For the project, you’ll use formal, written methods and more casual visual and audio methods of communication to demonstrate your ability to use language appropriate for different business contexts. The goal of this course is to demonstrate competence in writing and presenting a plan using skills and language appropriate for business.
Course Learning Objectives
•	Use appropriate vocabulary to write a mini business plan
•	Communicate a business plan orally in an organized and engaging presentation

title: Databases and SQL for Data Science with Python
description:
Working knowledge of SQL (or Structured Query Language) is a must for data professionals like Data Scientists, Data Analysts and Data Engineers. Much of the world's data resides in databases. SQL is a powerful language used for communicating with and extracting data from databases.
In this course you will learn SQL inside out- from the very basics of Select statements to
advanced concepts like JOINs. 
You will: 
-write foundational SQL statements like: SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE 
-filter result sets, use WHERE, COUNT, DISTINCT, and LIMIT clauses 
-differentiate between DML & DDL 
-CREATE, ALTER, DROP and load tables 
-use string patterns and ranges; ORDER and GROUP result sets, and built-in database functions
-build sub-queries and query data from multiple tables 
-access databases as a data scientist using Jupyter notebooks with SQL and Python
-work with advanced concepts like Stored Procedures, Views, ACID Transactions, Inner & Outer JOINs through hands-on labs and projects
You will practice building SQL queries, work with real databases on the Cloud, and use real data science tools. 
In the final project you’ll analyze multiple real-world datasets to demonstrate your skills.

title: My Unicorn Girl [Hindi]
description: When she was eighteen, Sang Tian makes a wish to enter her mother's school to become part of the Chinese figure skating team. However, she did not pass the ranking test but somehow disguises as a guy and was accepted into the Ice Hockey team. Having no choice, she adopted a new identity. However, her plan was foiled by the sudden appearance of Wen Bing. Wen Bing and Sang Tian become room-mates. After one encounter, the two former "arch enemies" suddenly become good friends. The two of them decide to work together with their team mates and do their best in the championships. However, Sang Tian's secret was eventually exposed. Despite this, she still gets the chance to become a member of the first all-female Ice Hockey team. Sang Tian is finally able to become a real girl and continue chasing her dream.
